chapters.name: Word List 1 数学（一）

words.ex: The point has an abscissa of 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个点的横坐标是5。
words.en: The abscissa is the horizontal coordinate in a system of Cartesian coordinates.

words.ex: The absolute value of -5 is 5.
words.ex_cn: -5 的绝对值是 5。
words.en: The magnitude of a real number without regard to its sign.

words.ex: The triangle has an acute angle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有一个锐角。
words.en: An acute angle is an angle that is less than 90 degrees. It is one of the basic types of angles in geometry.

words.ex: The addition of a new chair made the room more comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 增加一把新椅子让房间更舒适了。
words.en: An addition is something that is added to something else, often to improve it or make it larger.

words.tr: phrase. 邻角：共享一条公共边的一对角。
words.ex: The two adjacent angles form a straight line.
words.ex_cn: 这两个相邻的角组成一条直线。
words.en: An adjacent angle is one of a pair of angles with a common vertex and side but no interior points in common.

words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations.

words.ex: The computer uses an algorithm to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用一个算法来解决问题。
words.en: An algorithm is a set of rules or instructions that are followed in calculations or other problem-solving operations, especially by a computer.

words.ex: The angle bisector cuts the angle into two equal parts.
words.ex_cn: 角平分线将角分成两个相等的部分。
words.en: An angle bisector is a line or ray that divides an angle into two equal angles.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.tr:
v. 成弧线；
n. 弧；弧形物；
words.ex: The rainbow arcs across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹在天空中形成一道弧线。
words.en: An arc is a smoothly curving line or movement.

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.ex: He does arithmetic every day with his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和妹妹一起做算术。
words.en: Arithmetic is the part of mathematics that deals with the addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of numbers.

words.tr: phrase. 算术中项；算术平均
words.ex: The arithmetic mean of 4, 6, and 8 is 6.
words.ex_cn: 4、6和8的算术中项是6。
words.en: The arithmetic mean is the sum of a collection of numbers divided by the count of numbers in the collection.

words.tr: phrase. 等差数列：一种数列，其中任意一项与其前一项之间的差是恒定的。
words.ex: The sequence 2, 4, 6, 8 is an arithmetic progression.
words.ex_cn: 序列 2、4、6、8 是一个等差数列。
words.en: A sequence of numbers in which each term after the first is obtained by adding a constant difference to the preceding term.

words.tr:
n. 手臂；
v. 武装；
words.ex: He raised his arm to wave hello.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手臂打招呼。
words.en: An arm is one of the two long parts of your body that are attached to your shoulders and that have your hands at the end.

words.tr:
n. 平均数；平均水平；
adj. 平均的；普通的；
v. 平均为…；
words.ex: The average of 4, 5, and 6 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 4、5和6的平均数是5。
words.en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

words.tr: phrase. v.平均下来：在一段时间内产生一个均衡的结果。; 总体上来说：总体来看，有时你赢，有时你输，最终一切都会...
words.ex: The prices average out to $10 each.
words.ex_cn: 这些价格平均下来是每件10美元。
words.en: To calculate the mean of numbers or amounts, or to reach a typical level or amount after various increases and decreases.

words.ex: The line bisects the angle into two equal parts.
words.ex_cn: 这条线将角平分为两个相等的部分。
words.en: To divide something into two equal parts.

words.ex: He moved up to a higher bracket after his promotion.
words.ex_cn: 他升职后进入了更高的等级。
words.en: A bracket is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is fastened to a wall in order to support something such as a shelf. In writing, brackets are symbols that are used to separate words or numbers.

words.ex: The course covers a wide breadth of topics.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程涵盖了广泛的主题。
words.en: The distance or measurement from side to side of something; width.

words.ex: He uses a calculator to add numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算器来加数字。
words.en: A calculator is a small electronic device that you use for doing mathematical calculations.

words.tr: n. 微积分学；（人体内的）结石
words.ex: He is learning calculus at school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学校学习微积分。
words.en: Calculus is a branch of mathematics that deals with the finding and properties of derivatives and integrals of functions, by methods originally based on the summation of infinitesimal differences.

words.ex: The park is at the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 公园位于城市的中心。
words.en: The middle point or part of something; to place something in the middle of an area.

words.ex: The guitarist played a C major chord.
words.ex_cn: 吉他手弹了一个C大和弦。
words.en: A chord is a group of three or more musical notes played together.

words.ex: The coefficient of x is 5 in this equation.
words.ex_cn: 在这个方程中，x 的系数是 5。
words.en: A coefficient is a number that measures a particular characteristic of a substance or a system under specified conditions.

words.ex: The common divisor of 12 and 18 is 6.
words.ex_cn: 12 和 18 的公因数是 6。
words.en: A common divisor of two or more integers is an integer that divides each of them without leaving a remainder.

words.tr: phrase. 复合数：一个（非零）自然数，可以表示为两个（或更多）自然数的乘积，这些自然数不包括它本身和1。
words.ex: Four is a composite number because it has more than two factors.
words.ex_cn: 四是合数，因为它有超过两个因数。
words.en: A composite number is a positive integer that has at least one positive divisor other than one or itself.

words.ex: The circles are concentric and share the same center.
words.ex_cn: 这些圆是同心的，拥有同一个中心。
words.en: Having a common center, as circles or spheres.

words.ex: The two concentric circles have the same center.
words.ex_cn: 这两个同心圆有相同的圆心。
words.en: A concentric circle is a set of circles that all have the same center.

words.tr: n. 球果；松球；圆锥体；圆锥形物；
words.ex: The pine tree dropped a brown cone on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 松树掉下一个棕色的球果在地上。
words.en: A cone is a shape with a circular base that narrows to a point at the top.

words.tr: adj. 符合的；一致的；全等的
words.ex: The two shapes are congruent in size.
words.ex_cn: 这两个形状大小相符。
words.en: If one thing is congruent with another, they are similar or fit together well.

words.ex: The numbers 5, 6, and 7 are consecutive integers.
words.ex_cn: 数字5、6和7是连续整数。
words.en: An integer that follows another integer in order without any gaps.

words.ex: The child played with a wooden cube.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩了一个木制立方体。
words.en: A cube is a solid object with six square faces which are all the same size.

words.tr:
adj. 小数的；十进位的
n. 小数
words.ex: The decimal point separates the whole number from the decimal part.
words.ex_cn: 小数点将整数部分与小数部分分开。
words.en: A decimal is a fraction that is written in a special form. It is based on powers of ten, and it uses a decimal point to separate the whole number part from the fractional part.

words.ex: The denominator is 5 in the fraction 3/5.
words.ex_cn: 在分数 3/5 中，分母是 5。
words.en: The number below the line in a fraction that shows the number of equal parts into which the whole is divided.

words.tr:
adj. 对角线的；斜的
n. 对角线；斜线
words.ex: The square has two diagonal lines.
words.ex_cn: 这个正方形有两条对角线。
words.en: A diagonal line or movement goes in a sloping direction, for example, from one corner of a square across to the opposite corner.

words.ex: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。
words.en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.tr: n. 从0到9的任一数字；手指；脚趾；
words.ex: The password has four digits.
words.ex_cn: 这个密码有四位数字。
words.en: A digit is a written symbol for any of the numbers 0 to 9.

words.ex: The dimension of the box is 10 cm by 5 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米。
words.en: A dimension is a measurement of something in a particular direction, or the scope or scale of something.

words.tr: adj. 维度的；空间的；尺寸的
words.ex: The box has three dimensional shapes.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子有三个维度的形状。
words.en: Relating to measurements in length, width, and height, or to the spatial extent of something.

words.tr: phrase. 均分：将某物分成相等的部分或数量。
words.ex: The cake was divided evenly among the children.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕被平均分给了孩子们。
words.en: If something is divided evenly, it is split into equal parts or amounts.

words.tr: n. 被除数；股份红利；股息
words.ex: In 12 ÷ 3 = 4, the dividend is 12.
words.en: A dividend is a sum of money paid regularly (typically annually) by a company to its shareholders out of its profits (or reserves).

words.tr: adj. 可被整除的；可分的
words.ex: The number 12 is divisible by 3.
words.ex_cn: 12 能被 3 整除。
words.en: Capable of being divided, especially with no remainder.

words.ex: The divisor is 5 in this math problem.
words.ex_cn: 在这个数学题中，除数是5。
words.en: A divisor is a number by which another number is to be divided.

words.ex: The equation is easy to solve.
words.ex_cn: 这个方程式很容易解。
words.en: An equation is a mathematical statement that asserts the equality of two expressions.

words.ex: The triangle has three equal sides, so it is an equilateral triangle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有三条相等的边，所以它是一个等边三角形。
words.en: A triangle with all sides and angles equal.

words.ex: Four is an even number.
words.ex_cn: 四是偶数。
words.en: An even number is an integer that is divisible by two.

words.ex: The company used a new formula to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用了一个新方案来解决问题。
words.en: A formula is a plan or method that is used to achieve a particular goal, especially in science or mathematics.

words.ex: A fraction of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 只有一小部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: A fraction is a small part or amount of something.

words.ex: He drew a geometric shape on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个几何图形。
words.en: Relating to geometry, or according to its methods and principles.

words.tr: phrase. 几何平均数；等比中项
words.ex: The geometric mean of 4 and 9 is 6.
words.ex_cn: 4 和 9 的几何平均数是 6。
words.en: The geometric mean is a type of average that indicates the central tendency or typical value of a set of numbers by using the product of their values (as opposed to the arithmetic mean which uses their sum).

words.tr: phrase. 几何级数：一种数列，例如1、1/2、1/4等，其中每个数与它前面的数的比值始终相同。
words.ex: The sequence 2, 4, 8, 16 is a geometric progression.
words.ex_cn: 序列 2、4、8、16 是一个等比数列。
words.en: A sequence of numbers where each term after the first is found by multiplying the previous one by a fixed, non-zero number called the common ratio.

words.ex: The bee built a hexagon with wax.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造了一个六边形。
words.en: A hexagon is a six-sided polygon.

words.ex: The hypotenuse is the longest side of a right triangle.
words.ex_cn: 斜边是直角三角形中最长的一条边。
words.en: The side opposite the right angle in a right-angled triangle.

words.ex: The fraction 7/3 is an improper fraction.
words.ex_cn: 分数 7/3 是一个假分式。
words.en: An improper fraction is a fraction in which the numerator is greater than or equal to the denominator.

words.ex: The temperature increases by one increment every hour.
words.ex_cn: 温度每小时增加一个单位。
words.en: An increment is an amount by which something increases or is increased.

words.tr: n. 指标；索引；指数；“index”的复数
words.ex: The company tracks key indices to measure performance.
words.ex_cn: 该公司追踪关键指标以衡量表现。
words.en: Indices are used to measure or indicate something, such as economic health or the performance of a stock market.

words.ex: The number 5 is an integer.
words.ex_cn: 数字5是一个整数。
words.en: An integer is a whole number that can be positive, negative, or zero.

words.tr: adj. 不变的; n. [数] 不变量；[计] 不变式
words.ex: The speed of light is invariant in all frames.
words.ex_cn: 光速在所有参考系中都是不变的。
words.en: An invariant is something that does not change or is not affected by changes in other things.

words.tr: adj. 二等边的，[数] 等腰的
words.ex: The triangle has two equal sides, so it is isosceles.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有两条相等的边，所以它是等腰三角形。
words.en: An isosceles triangle is a triangle with two sides of equal length.

words.ex: The triangle has two equal sides, so it is an isosceles triangle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有两条相等的边，所以它是等腰三角形。
words.en: A triangle with at least two sides of equal length.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: A leg is one of the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.ex: The length of the table is two meters.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的长度是两米。
words.en: The measurement or extent of something from end to end; the greater of two or the greatest of three dimensions of a body.

words.ex: He loves mathematics because it is logical.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它有逻辑性。
words.en: Mathematics is the study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using reason and usually a special system of symbols and rules for organizing them.

words.ex: The matrix gave birth to all living things.
words.ex_cn: 母体孕育了所有生命。
words.en: A matrix is a rectangular array of numbers, symbols, or expressions, arranged in rows and columns.

words.tr:
n. 中位数；（三角形的）中线
adj. 中间值的；中间的
words.ex: The median of 3, 5, and 7 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 3、5和7的中位数是5。
words.en: The median is the middle number in a sorted, ascending or descending, list of numbers and can be more descriptive of that data set than the average.

words.tr: phrase. 三角形的中线：三角形中从某边的中点连向对角的顶点的线段。
words.ex: The median of a triangle goes from a corner to the middle of the opposite side.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的中线从一个顶点连接到对边的中点。
words.en: In geometry, a median of a triangle is a line segment joining a vertex to the midpoint of the opposing side.

words.ex: The midpoint of the line is at 5.
words.ex_cn: 这条线的中点在5处。
words.en: A midpoint is the exact middle point of something, such as a line segment, where it is equally distant from both ends.

words.ex: The bug is five millimeters long.
words.ex_cn: 这只虫子五毫米长。
words.en: A unit of length equal to one thousandth of a meter.

words.tr:
adj. 零下的；负的；
n. 缺点；
prep. 减去；
words.ex: The temperature is minus ten degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 气温是零下十摄氏度。
words.en: A minus is a mathematical symbol that represents subtraction or a negative quantity.

chapters.name: Word List 2 数学（二）

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.ex: The bacteria multiply quickly.
words.ex_cn: 细菌迅速增加。
words.en: If you multiply one number by another, you add the first number to itself as many times as is indicated by the second number. For example, 2 multiplied by 3 is equal to 6.

words.ex: Five is a natural number.
words.ex_cn: 五是一个自然数。
words.en: A natural number is a positive integer used in counting and ordering.

words.ex: The temperature is a negative number: -5 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 温度是一个负数：-5度。
words.en: A negative number is a real number that is less than zero.

words.ex: The number on the door is 5.
words.ex_cn: 门上的数字是5。
words.en: A number is a word or symbol that represents an amount or a quantity.

words.tr: phrase. 数轴；数字线（数学中用于表示数字顺序的直线）
words.ex: He draws number lines to understand addition.
words.ex_cn: 他画数轴来理解加法。
words.en: A visual representation of numbers in order on a straight line, often used to teach arithmetic and number sense.

words.ex: The numerator is 5 in the fraction 5/8.
words.ex_cn: 在分数 5/8 中，分子是 5。
words.en: The numerator is the top number in a fraction that shows how many parts of the whole are being considered.

words.ex: The test has only numerical answers.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试只有数字答案。
words.en: Numerical means relating to numbers or consisting of numbers.

words.ex: The triangle has an obtuse angle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有一个钝角。
words.en: An angle that is greater than 90 degrees but less than 180 degrees.

words.ex: The stop sign is an octagon.
words.ex_cn: 交通标志是一个八边形。
words.en: An octagon is a polygon with eight sides and eight angles.

words.ex: Three is an odd number.
words.ex_cn: 三是一个奇数。
words.en: An odd number is an integer that is not divisible by two.

words.ex: The point has an ordinate of 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个点的纵坐标是5。
words.en: In mathematics, an ordinate is the y-coordinate of a point in a two-dimensional Cartesian coordinate system.

words.ex: The two lines are parallel lines and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行线，从不相交。
words.en: Lines that are always the same distance apart and never meet.

words.ex: The shape has four sides, and opposite sides are parallel; it is a parallelogram.
words.ex_cn: 这个形状有四条边，对边平行；它是一个平行四边形。
words.en: A parallelogram is a four-sided plane rectilinear figure with opposite sides parallel.

words.ex: The teacher changed the parameter to make the test easier.
words.ex_cn: 老师更改了参数，使测试更容易。
words.en: A parameter is a limit or boundary which defines the scope of a particular process or activity.

words.ex: The pentagon is a five-sided shape.
words.ex_cn: 五边形是一个五边的形状。
words.en: A pentagon is a five-sided polygon.

words.ex: The fence marks the perimeter of the garden.
words.ex_cn: 围栏标出了花园的边界。
words.en: The perimeter of an area or object is the total length of its sides or outer boundary.

words.tr: n. 排列；排列中的任一组数字或文字
words.ex: He solved the permutation problem in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上解出了这个排列问题。
words.en: A permutation is a way in which a set of things can be ordered or arranged.

words.tr:
adj. 垂直的；笔直的
n. 垂直线
words.ex: The lines are perpendicular to each other.
words.ex_cn: 这些线互相垂直。
words.en: At right angles to the plane of the horizon or a base line; vertical.

words.ex: The plane landed safely at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场安全着陆。
words.en: A plane is a vehicle designed for air travel that has wings and one or more engines.

words.tr:
prep. 加；加上；
conj. 加；和；并且；
n. 优势；
words.ex: Five plus three is eight.
words.ex_cn: 五加三等于八。
words.en: Used to indicate addition, or a positive quality or factor.

words.ex: He drew a pentagon, which is a polygon.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个五边形，它是一个多边形。
words.en: A polygon is a flat shape with three or more straight sides and angles.

words.ex: Five is a positive number.
words.ex_cn: 五是一个正数。
words.en: A positive number is a real number that is greater than zero.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.tr: phrase. 质因数：一个质数作为因数的因数。
words.ex: The prime factor of 7 is 7.
words.ex_cn: 7的质因数是7。
words.en: A prime factor is a factor of a number that is a prime number.

words.ex: Seven is a prime number.
words.ex_cn: 七是一个质数。
words.en: A prime number is a whole number greater than 1 that cannot be exactly divided by any whole number other than itself and 1.

words.ex: This company makes a new product every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年都会推出一种新产品。
words.en: A product is something that is produced and sold in large quantities, often as a result of a manufacturing process.

words.tr: phrase. 真分数（分子小于分母的分数）
words.ex: The fraction 3/4 is a proper fraction.
words.ex_cn: 分数 3/4 是一个真分数。
words.en: A fraction where the numerator is less than the denominator, and the value is less than one.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.tr: n. 四分之一圆周；象限；四分仪
words.ex: The point lies in the first quadrant of the circle.
words.ex_cn: 这个点位于圆的四分之一圆周的第一象限。
words.en: A quadrant is one of the four equal parts into which a circle is divided by two lines that cross each other at right angles.

words.tr:
adj. 二次方的
n. 二次方程式
words.ex: He solved a quadratic equation yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天解了一个二次方程。
words.en: In mathematics, a quadratic equation is any equation that can be rearranged in standard form as ax² + bx + c = 0, where x represents an unknown, and a, b, and c represent known numbers, with a ≠ 0.

words.tr:
adj. 四边的；四边形的
n. 四边形
words.ex: The quadrilateral shape has four sides.
words.ex_cn: 这个四边的形状有四条边。
words.en: A quadrilateral is a polygon with four sides and four angles.

words.ex: The company's profits quadrupled last year.
words.ex_cn: 公司去年的利润增长了四倍。
words.en: To quadruple something means to make it four times as great in size, amount, or number.

words.ex: The quotient of 10 divided by 2 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 10除以2的商是5。
words.en: A quotient is the result you get by dividing one number by another.

words.tr:
adj. 辐射状的；放射式的；径向的；星形的
n. 子午线轮胎；辐射式轮胎
words.ex: The wheels have radial tires.
words.ex_cn: 这些车轮装有径向轮胎。
words.en: Relating to or situated near the radius or the radial side of the forearm or hand.

words.ex: The new policy has a wide radius of influence.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策的影响范围很广。
words.en: A straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere.

words.ex: The ratio of boys to girls is 3 to 2.
words.ex_cn: 男孩与女孩的比例是3比2。
words.en: A ratio is a relationship between two numbers indicating how many times the first number contains the second.

words.ex: The box has a rectangle shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是长方形的。
words.en: A rectangle is a four-sided flat shape where every interior angle is a right angle (90°). Opposite sides are parallel and of equal length.

words.tr: phrase. 长方体：一个有六个矩形面的多面体，其中所有角都是直角，且相对的面积相等。
words.ex: The box is a rectangular prism.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是一个长方体。
words.en: A rectangular prism is a three-dimensional figure with six faces, all of which are rectangles.

words.tr: 正多边形：既等角又等边的多边形，也就是所有边长相等且所有内角相等的多边形。
words.ex: A square is a regular polygon with four equal sides.
words.ex_cn: 正方形是一个有四条相等边的正多边形。
words.en: A regular polygon is a polygon that is equiangular and equilateral, meaning that all sides are of equal length and all interior angles are of equal measure.

words.ex: The remainder of the cake was given to the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的剩余部分给了邻居。
words.en: The remainder is what is left over after other parts have been taken away or used.

words.ex: The shape has four equal sides and is called a rhombus.
words.ex_cn: 这个形状有四条相等的边，叫做菱形。
words.en: A rhombus is a quadrilateral all of whose sides are of equal length.

words.tr: phrase. 直角：指一个角度为90°的角。
words.ex: The triangle has a right angle.
words.ex_cn: 这个三角形有一个直角。
words.en: An angle of 90°, as in a corner of a square or at the intersection of two perpendicular straight lines.

words.ex: The right triangle has one 90-degree angle.
words.ex_cn: 这个直角三角形有一个90度的角。
words.en: A right triangle is a triangle in which one angle is a right angle (90 degrees).

words.tr: n. （英）[数]梯形（等于 trapezoid）；（美）[数]不规则四边形；大多角骨
words.ex: He drew a trapezium on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个梯形。
words.en: A trapezium is a quadrilateral with no sides parallel.

chapters.name: Word List 3 经济

words.tr: n. （英）[数]梯形（等于 trapezoid）；（美）[数]不规则四边形；大多角骨
words.ex: He drew a trapezium on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一个梯形。
words.en: A trapezium is a quadrilateral with no sides parallel.

words.ex: The company hired an expert to do an audit.
words.ex_cn: 公司聘请了一位专家进行审计。
words.en: An audit is an official examination of the accounts of a business or organization to check that they are accurate and correct.

words.ex: The company is bankrupt after losing all its money.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司失去所有钱后破产了。
words.en: If a person or a company is bankrupt, they have been declared by a court of law to be unable to pay their debts.

words.tr: n. 借用的言语（或思想等）； v. 借；借用；“borrow”的现在分词；
words.ex: His poem shows a lot of borrowing from old folk tales.
words.ex_cn: 他的诗大量借用民间故事的言语。
words.en: The act of taking and using something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.tr: n. 经纪业务；经纪人佣金（或回扣）
words.ex: He works at a brokerage firm.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家经纪公司工作。
words.en: A brokerage is a company that buys and sells shares, bonds, and other investments for people and organizations.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.tr: adj. 资本主义的；资本家的
words.ex: He lives in a capitalistic society.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在一个资本主义社会。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by capitalism, an economic system based on private ownership of the means of production and their operation for profit.

words.tr:
adj. 贸易的；商业的；
n. 广告；
words.ex: The commercial ship sailed to another country.
words.ex_cn: 这艘贸易船只驶向了另一个国家。
words.en: Commercial relates to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: The bank pays compound interest every year.
words.ex_cn: 银行每年支付复利。
words.en: Compound interest is interest calculated on the initial principal and also on the accumulated interest of previous periods of a deposit or loan.

words.ex: The consortium helps small businesses share resources.
words.ex_cn: 这个协会帮助小企业共享资源。
words.en: A consortium is a group of companies or organizations who have agreed to work together on a particular project or in a particular area of business.

words.tr: n. 优惠券；息票；配给券
words.ex: He used a coupon to buy milk at half price.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张优惠券以半价买了牛奶。
words.en: A coupon is a piece of printed paper that allows you to pay less money than usual for a product, or to get it free.

words.ex: The currency in Japan is the yen.
words.ex_cn: 日本的货币是日元。
words.en: The system of money in general use in a particular country.

words.ex: The country has a budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年这个国家的预算不足额。
words.en: A deficit is the amount by which something, especially a sum of money, is too small.

words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.ex: This car is economical because it uses little fuel.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车很经济，因为它耗油少。
words.en: Using money, resources, or time in a careful and effective way.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.tr: 金融崩溃：指金融市场上突然发生的大规模资产价格暴跌，导致金融机构破产、信贷紧缩和经济衰退。
words.ex: The financial crash in 2008 hurt many banks and jobs.
words.ex_cn: 2008年的金融崩溃伤害了许多银行和工作。
words.en: A financial crash is a sudden dramatic decline of stock prices across a significant cross-section of a stock market, resulting in a significant loss of paper wealth.

words.ex: The government made a fiscal decision to lower taxes.
words.ex_cn: 政府做出了降低税收的财政决定。
words.en: Fiscal is used to describe something that relates to government money or public money, especially taxes.

words.ex: The free market decides the price of bread.
words.ex_cn: 自由市场决定面包的价格。
words.en: An economic system in which prices are determined by unrestricted competition between privately owned businesses.

words.tr: abbr. 国民生产总值；“gross national product”的缩写
words.ex: The country's GNP increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 该国的国民生产总值去年有所增长。
words.en: The total value of goods produced and services provided by a country during one year, equal to the gross domestic product plus the net income from foreign investments.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.ex: The price of bread went up because of inflation.
words.ex_cn: 由于通货膨胀，面包的价格上涨了。
words.en: Inflation is a general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.

words.ex: The bank raised the interest rate last month.
words.ex_cn: 银行上个月提高了利率。
words.en: The interest rate is the percentage of an amount of money which is paid for its use for a specified time, usually expressed as an annual percentage rate.

words.ex: The store made an inventory of all the products.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有商品做了一份清单。
words.en: An inventory is a detailed list of all the items in a place.

words.ex: He made an investment in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他投资了一家小企业。
words.en: An investment is an amount of money that you invest in something.

words.tr: v. 增添活力；振奋；使活跃
words.ex: The fresh air invigorates me every morning.
words.ex_cn: 每天早晨的新鲜空气让我精神焕发。
words.en: If something invigorates you, it makes you feel more energetic and alive.

words.tr: adj. 凯恩斯主义的；以凯恩斯经济理论为基础的
words.ex: He believes in keynesian economics to fix unemployment.
words.ex_cn: 他相信凯恩斯主义经济学可以解决失业问题。
words.en: Keynesian refers to the economic theories and policies advocated by John Maynard Keynes, especially the idea that government intervention is necessary to stabilize the economy and achieve full employment.

words.tr: phrase. 自由放任资本主义；一种政府极少干预市场、强调自由竞争和私有产权的经济体制
words.ex: He believes in laissez-faire capitalism and wants minimal government control.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自由放任的资本主义，希望政府干预最少。
words.en: An economic system in which transactions between private parties are free from government intervention such as regulation, privileges, tariffs, and subsidies.

words.tr: phrase. 标价；定价；目录价格；官方零售价
words.ex: The list price of the book is $20.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的标价是20美元。
words.en: The original, advertised selling price of an item before any discounts or negotiations.

words.ex: He has a managerial role in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司中担任管理职务。
words.en: relating to the job of a manager

words.tr: n. 差额；边缘；净利润；余地；
words.ex: The profit margin is five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 利润差额是五美元。
words.en: The margin is the edge or border of something, or the difference between two amounts, especially the difference between the cost of producing something and the price it is sold for.

words.tr: n. 加价；毛利；涨价幅度
words.ex: The store adds a 20% markup to the cost of goods.
words.ex_cn: 商店在商品成本上加了20%的利润。
words.en: The amount added to the cost price of goods to cover overhead and profit.

words.tr: n. 标低价，[物价] 减价
words.ex: The store gave a markdown on all summer clothes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有夏季服装进行了减价。
words.en: A reduction in the price of something, especially in a retail context.

words.tr: n. 重商主义者; adj. 重商主义的
words.ex: The mercantilist believed that gold made a nation strong.
words.ex_cn: 这位重商主义者认为黄金使国家强大。
words.en: A mercantilist is someone who believes in or supports mercantilism, an economic theory that advocates government regulation of a nation's economy for the purpose of augmenting state power at the expense of rival national powers.

words.ex: The store sells cheap merchandise.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售廉价商品。
words.en: Goods to be bought and sold.

words.ex: The monetary policy affects prices.
words.ex_cn: 货币政策影响价格。
words.en: Monetary means relating to money, especially the total amount of money in a country.

words.ex: He took out a mortgage to buy his first house.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔抵押贷款来购买他的第一套房子。
words.en: A mortgage is a loan of money which you get from a bank or building society in order to buy a house.

words.ex: The coin is made of nickel.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币是镍制的。
words.en: A hard silver-white metal that is used in making alloys and is a chemical element. It is also a coin worth five cents in the US and Canada.

words.tr: n. 出口；发泄途径；经销店；折扣店
words.ex: The river flows out through an outlet.
words.ex_cn: 河水通过一个出口流出。
words.en: An outlet is a hole or pipe through which liquid or air can flow out, or a point in a wall where you can connect electrical equipment to the electricity supply.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.tr: n. 养老金；退休金；抚恤金；
words.ex: He receives a monthly pension after retiring.
words.ex_cn: 他退休后每月领取养老金。
words.en: A pension is a sum of money which a retired, widowed, or disabled person regularly receives from the state or from a former employer.

words.ex: The income per capita is high in this country.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的人均收入很高。
words.en: Per capita is used to describe the average amount of something per person in a particular place.

words.tr: n. 额外费用；保险费；溢价；
words.ex: You need to pay a premium for faster delivery.
words.ex_cn: 你需要支付额外费用才能享受更快的配送。
words.en: A premium is an amount of money that you pay regularly to an insurance company for an insurance policy, or an amount of money that is more than usual for a product or service because it is of higher quality.

words.tr: v. 使私有化；将…私营化
words.ex: The government wants to privatize the train company.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望将铁路公司私有化。
words.en: If a company, industry, or service that is owned by the state is privatized, the government sells it and makes it a private company.

words.ex: The proceeds from the sale went to charity.
words.ex_cn: 销售所得收益捐给了慈善机构。
words.en: Proceeds are the money that is received from a particular event or activity, especially when it is used for a specific purpose.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.ex: This small business is profitable.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业有利可图的。
words.en: If something is profitable, it makes a profit or is beneficial.

words.tr: phrase. 采购价格；进货价；购买价格
words.ex: The purchasing price of the phone was low.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的购买价格很低。
words.en: The amount of money paid by a buyer to acquire a good or service, often from a supplier or manufacturer.

words.ex: The factory has a quota of 1000 units per day.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂每天有1000件的配额。
words.en: A quota is the limited number or quantity of something which is officially allowed.

words.tr:
n. 率；速度；比率；价格；费用；
v. 被评价；定级；（被）认为；
words.ex: The interest rate is very low this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的利率非常低。
words.en: A rate is the speed at which something happens or changes, or the amount or number of something that happens or changes in a particular period.

words.ex: The movie got a high rating from viewers.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影获得了观众的高评分。
words.en: A rating is a classification or ranking of someone or something based on a comparative assessment of their quality, standard, or performance.

words.ex: He works in real estate in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事房地产行业。
words.en: Real estate refers to property consisting of land or buildings.

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.ex: Many people lost jobs during the recession.
words.ex_cn: 在经济不景气期间，许多人失去了工作。
words.en: A recession is a period when the economy of a country is not doing well, industrial production and business activity are at a low level, and many people are unemployed.

words.tr: adj. 反复出现的；再发生的；
words.ex: He has recurrent headaches every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都反复出现头痛。
words.en: Happening or appearing again or repeatedly.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.ex: The sale price of the shirt is $10.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫的促销价是10美元。
words.en: The price at which something is offered for sale.

words.tr: phrase. 简单利息：仅根据贷款的原始本金或账户金额计算或支付的利息。
words.ex: He earned simple interest on his savings.
words.ex_cn: 他从储蓄中获得了简单利息。
words.en: Interest calculated only on the principal amount of a loan or deposit, and not on previously earned interest.

words.tr: phrase. 经济不景气的；经济疲软的；经济迟滞的
words.ex: The sluggish economy made it hard for small businesses to survive.
words.ex_cn: 经济不景气使小企业难以生存。
words.en: An economic condition characterized by slow growth, low consumer spending, and reduced business activity.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: He receives a small stipend for his internship.
words.ex_cn: 他因实习获得少量薪金。
words.en: A stipend is a sum of money paid regularly as a salary or allowance.

words.tr:
n. 库存；股票；家畜；
v. 备有；贮存；
words.ex: The store has low stock of winter coats.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的冬衣库存很少。
words.en: The supply of goods available for sale in a store; the capital raised by a company through the issue of shares.

words.tr:
v. 分包；转包
n. 分包合同；转包契约
words.ex: The company subcontracted the work to a small firm.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司把工作分包给了一家小公司。
words.en: To subcontract means to arrange for work to be done by another company or person as part of a larger project.

words.ex: The government subsidize small businesses to help them grow.
words.ex_cn: 政府资助小企业以帮助它们发展。
words.en: To subsidize something means to pay part of the cost of it, usually as a way of helping people or organizations that cannot afford to pay the full cost themselves.

words.ex: The government gives a subsidy to farmers.
words.ex_cn: 政府向农民提供补贴。
words.en: A subsidy is money that is paid by a government or other authority in order to help an industry or business, or to pay for a public service.

words.ex: The farm has a surplus of apples this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年农场苹果过剩。
words.en: A surplus is an amount of something that is extra or more than what is needed.

words.tr: n. 关税；税率；（旅馆、饭店等的）价目表
words.ex: The government raised the tariff on imported cars.
words.ex_cn: 政府提高了进口汽车的关税。
words.en: A tariff is a tax that a government collects on goods coming into a country.

words.ex: The bank recorded the transaction quickly.
words.ex_cn: 银行迅速记录了这笔交易。
words.en: A transaction is an instance of buying or selling something; a business deal.

words.ex: The treasury decided to lower taxes.
words.ex_cn: 财政部决定降低税收。
words.en: The treasury is the department within a government that manages its finances, including the collection of taxes and the allocation of funds.

chapters.name: Word List 4 医学（一）

words.ex: The treasury decided to lower taxes.
words.ex_cn: 财政部决定降低税收。
words.en: The treasury is the department within a government that manages its finances, including the collection of taxes and the allocation of funds.

words.ex: The ambulance arrived quickly to help the injured man.
words.ex_cn: 救护车迅速到达以帮助受伤的男人。
words.en: An ambulance is a vehicle equipped to transport the sick or injured, especially to a hospital.

words.tr: n. 苯丙胺（中枢兴奋药）；安非他命
words.ex: He took amphetamine to stay awake.
words.ex_cn: 他服用了安非他明来保持清醒。
words.en: Amphetamine is a synthetic, addictive, mood-altering drug, used illegally as a stimulant and legally as a prescription drug to treat children with ADD and adults with narcolepsy.

words.ex: He took an analgesic for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了止痛药来缓解头痛。
words.en: An analgesic is a drug that is used to relieve pain.

words.tr:
n. 麻醉剂；麻醉药
adj. 麻醉的
words.ex: The doctor gave him an anesthetic before the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 医生在手术前给他用了麻醉剂。
words.en: An anesthetic is a substance that causes loss of sensation or consciousness, used especially to prevent pain during medical procedures.

words.tr: adj. （多指药物）治疗精神紊乱的; n. 抑制精神病药
words.ex: He takes antipsychotic medicine to calm his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他服用抗精神病药物来平静心情。
words.en: An antipsychotic is a type of drug used to treat psychosis, including schizophrenia and bipolar disorder.

words.tr:
adj. 收敛性的；止血的；辛辣的；严厉的；涩的
n. 收敛剂； 止血药
words.ex: The astringent lotion helps reduce swelling.
words.ex_cn: 这种收敛性的爽肤水有助于减轻肿胀。
words.en: An astringent substance causes the contraction of body tissues, typically used to reduce bleeding from minor abrasions or as a skin toner.

words.tr: adj. 癌的；癌性的；似癌的
words.ex: The doctor found a cancerous tumor in his lung.
words.ex_cn: 医生在他的肺里发现了一个癌性肿瘤。
words.en: Relating to or affected with cancer.

words.ex: The doctor gave him a clinical exam.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他做了临床检查。
words.en: Clinical means involving or relating to the direct observation and treatment of patients, rather than theoretical or laboratory studies.

words.tr: phrase. 冠状动脉造影：一种医学检查方法，通过向冠状动脉注入造影剂，然后使用X射线或其他影像技术来观察冠状动脉...
words.ex: The doctor did a coronary angiography to check his heart.
words.ex_cn: 医生做了冠状动脉造影来检查他的心脏。
words.en: A medical imaging technique used to visualize the inside, or lumen, of blood vessels and organs of the body, with particular interest in the arteries, veins, and the heart chambers.

words.ex: The doctor can diagnose the illness quickly.
words.ex_cn: 医生能很快诊断出这种病。
words.en: If someone or something is diagnosed as having a particular illness or problem, their illness or problem is identified. If an illness or problem is diagnosed, it is identified.

words.tr:
n. 麻醉剂；毒品；内幕消息；笨蛋
v. 给…用兴奋剂（或麻醉剂）；掺杂
words.ex: He was arrested for selling dope on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他因在街上贩卖麻醉剂而被逮捕。
words.en: Dope can refer to a drug that is illegal or a piece of information that is not generally known.

words.ex: The doctor adjusted the dosage of the medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生调整了药物的剂量。
words.en: The amount of a medicine or drug that is taken at one time or over a period of time.

words.ex: The doctor gave him a small dose of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一小剂量的药。
words.en: A dose of a medicine or a drug is the amount of it that you take at one time, or the amount that is recommended for you to take.

words.tr: n. 机能不良；功能障碍，功能紊乱; adj. 缺乏正常功能的
words.ex: The injury caused a disfunction in his leg.
words.ex_cn: 这次受伤导致他的腿部出现机能不良。
words.en: The state of not functioning properly; a breakdown or impairment in the normal operation of a system or process.

words.tr: n. [药][微] 红霉素（抗生素的一种）
words.ex: The doctor gave him erythromycin for his sore throat.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了红霉素治疗喉咙痛。
words.en: Erythromycin is an antibiotic used to treat a wide variety of bacterial infections. It works by stopping the growth of bacteria.

words.ex: The hospital uses a hypertherm to warm the patient's body.
words.ex_cn: 医院使用人工发热机为病人升温。
words.en: A therapeutic procedure that involves the application of high temperatures to the body for the treatment of disease.

words.ex: He is learning immunology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习免疫学。
words.en: The branch of medicine and biology concerned with immunity.

words.tr: adj. 传染性的；有感染力的；
words.ex: The virus is infectious and spreads quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒具有传染性，传播迅速。
words.en: An infectious disease can be passed from one person to another, especially through the air they breathe.

words.ex: This drug is an inhibitor of pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物是一种止痛抑制剂。
words.en: A substance that slows down or prevents a particular chemical reaction or other process, or that reduces the activity of a particular reactant, catalyst, or enzyme.

words.tr: v. 预防注射；接种疫苗
words.ex: The doctor will inoculate the child against measles.
words.ex_cn: 医生会给这个孩子接种麻疹疫苗。
words.en: To inoculate someone against a disease means to inject a weak form of the disease into their body as a way of protecting them against it.

words.tr:
n. 住院病人
adj. 住院的
words.ex: The inpatient stayed in the hospital for three days.
words.ex_cn: 这位住院病人在医院住了三天。
words.en: An inpatient is someone who stays in a hospital while they receive medical treatment.

words.ex: He has insomnia and cannot sleep at night.
words.ex_cn: 他有失眠症，晚上睡不着。
words.en: If someone suffers from insomnia, they find it difficult to sleep.

words.ex: He takes insulin to control his blood sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他注射胰岛素来控制血糖。
words.en: A hormone produced in the pancreas by the islets of Langerhans, which regulates the amount of glucose in the blood. The lack of insulin causes a form of diabetes.

words.ex: The intestine helps digest food.
words.ex_cn: 肠道帮助消化食物。
words.en: The part of the alimentary canal between the stomach and the anus.

words.tr: n. 刺激物；令人烦恼的事物；
words.ex: Smoke is an irritant to the eyes.
words.ex_cn: 烟雾对眼睛是一种刺激物。
words.en: An irritant is something that causes irritation, especially physical irritation.

words.ex: He drank water to help his kidney work better.
words.ex_cn: 他喝水以帮助肾脏更好地工作。
words.en: One of the two organs in your lower back that separate waste products from your blood and make urine.

words.ex: He eats too much sugar and his liver is hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多糖，他的肝脏受损了。
words.en: The liver is a large organ in the body that cleans the blood and produces bile, or a person who lives in a particular way.

words.ex: He has a rare malady that doctors are trying to cure.
words.ex_cn: 他患有一种罕见的疾病，医生们正在努力治疗。
words.en: A malady is a disease or illness.

words.ex: He got malaria from a mosquito bite.
words.ex_cn: 他被蚊子叮咬后得了疟疾。
words.en: Malaria is a disease caused by a parasite that is transmitted to humans through the bites of infected mosquitoes.

words.tr: adj. 癫狂的；疯狂的；狂躁的
words.ex: He was manic after staying up for three days.
words.ex_cn: 他连续三天没睡觉后变得狂躁不安。
words.en: If you describe someone as manic, you mean that they are in a state of great excitement or anxiety, often making them behave in a wild or uncontrolled way.

words.ex: He smokes marijuana on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末吸大麻。
words.en: A drug made from the dried leaves and flowers of the hemp plant, which is smoked or eaten to induce euphoria.

words.tr: n. 骨髓；精华；活力；西葫芦
words.ex: The bone marrow makes blood cells.
words.ex_cn: 骨髓制造血细胞。
words.en: The soft fatty substance in the cavities of bones, in which blood cells are produced; the essence or most vital part of something.

words.ex: He had measles when he was five.
words.ex_cn: 他五岁时得了麻疹。
words.en: An infectious disease that causes fever and small red spots on the skin.

words.tr: n. 药物；药物治疗；药物处理；
words.ex: He took his medication every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: Medication refers to a substance used for medical treatment, especially a medicine or drug.

words.ex: He has a migraine every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都偏头痛。
words.en: A migraine is a severe, often painful headache that can be accompanied by nausea, vomiting, and sensitivity to light and sound.

words.ex: The doctor gave him morphine for the pain.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他吗啡来止痛。
words.en: A powerful drug that is used to relieve severe pain, especially after surgery or in terminal illness.

words.tr: adj. 有关形态发生的；地貌成因的
words.ex: The embryo shows morphogenetic changes during development.
words.ex_cn: 胚胎在发育过程中显示出形态发生的变化。
words.en: Relating to the development of the form of an organism or part.

words.tr:
n. 麻醉药；镇定剂；致幻毒品
adj. 麻醉的；催眠的
words.ex: He took a narcotic for his pain.
words.ex_cn: 他服了一种麻醉药来缓解疼痛。
words.en: A narcotic is a drug that dulls the senses, relieves pain, and induces sleep. It can also refer to something that has a soothing or numbing effect.

words.ex: The smell of the food made her feel nausea.
words.ex_cn: 食物的气味让她感到恶心。
words.en: A feeling of sickness with an inclination to vomit.

words.ex: He quit smoking to avoid nicotine.
words.ex_cn: 他戒烟以避免尼古丁。
words.en: Nicotine is a toxic colorless or yellowish oily liquid that is the chief active constituent of tobacco. It acts as a stimulant in small doses, but in larger amounts blocks the action of autonomic nerve and skeletal muscle cells.

words.ex: He bought an off-the-shelf computer for his work.
words.ex_cn: 他为工作买了一台现成的电脑。
words.en: Something that is off-the-shelf is available immediately and does not need to be specially made or ordered.

words.tr:
n. 麻醉剂；鸦片制剂
adj. 含鸦片的；催眠性的
v. 加鸦片麻醉；使（感觉）迟钝；使缓和
words.ex: He took an opiate for his pain.
words.ex_cn: 他服了一种鸦片类药物来缓解疼痛。
words.en: An opiate is a drug that contains opium or a derivative of opium, used to relieve pain or induce sleep.

words.ex: He visits the hospital as an outpatient every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周作为门诊病人去医院。
words.en: A patient who receives medical treatment without being admitted to a hospital.

words.ex: He thinks this new pill is a panacea for all diseases.
words.ex_cn: 他认为这种新药是治百病的万应药。
words.en: A panacea is a remedy for all diseases or ills.

words.ex: The accident caused paralysis in his legs.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故导致他双腿瘫痪。
words.en: Paralysis is the loss of the ability to move and sometimes to feel anything in part or most of the body, typically as a result of illness, poison, or injury.

words.ex: The pediatric doctor checks children's health.
words.ex_cn: 儿科医生检查儿童的健康。
words.en: Pediatric refers to the branch of medicine dealing with the health and medical care of infants, children, and adolescents from birth up to the age of 18.

words.ex: The doctor gave him penicillin for his infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了青霉素治疗感染。
words.en: An antibiotic drug obtained from molds or produced synthetically, used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

words.tr:
adj. 制药的；配药的；
n. 药物；
words.ex: He works at a pharmaceutical company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家制药公司工作。
words.en: relating to the production and sale of medicinal drugs

words.ex: He works at a small pharmacy near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一家小药房工作。
words.en: A pharmacy is a shop or a department in a shop where medicines are prepared and sold.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.tr:
n. 瘟疫；疫病；
v. 困扰；折磨；
words.ex: The plague killed many people in medieval Europe.
words.ex_cn: 瘟疫在中世纪的欧洲杀死了许多人。
words.en: A plague is a very infectious disease that spreads quickly and kills a lot of people. It can also refer to a large number of insects or animals that cause damage or are a nuisance.

words.tr: n. 匾额；饰板；薄金属板；齿菌斑
words.ex: The plaque on the wall honors the founder of the school.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的匾额纪念这所学校的创始人。
words.en: A plaque is a flat piece of metal or stone with writing on it that is fixed to a wall or other structure to remind people of an important person or event.

words.ex: He got pneumonia after a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他得了重感冒后患了肺炎。
words.en: Pneumonia is a serious disease which affects your lungs and makes it difficult for you to breathe.

words.ex: The doctor wrote a prescription for medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了一张药方。
words.en: A prescription is a written order from a physician for the preparation and administration of a drug or device for a patient.

words.tr: adj. 专卖的；专利的；所有权的
words.ex: The company uses proprietary software to protect its data.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用专有软件来保护其数据。
words.en: Relating to an owner or ownership; exclusive rights of possession, use, or control.

words.tr: adj. 精神病的；精神病学的；
words.ex: He works in a psychiatric hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家精神病医院工作。
words.en: Psychiatric means relating to psychiatry or to mental illness.

words.tr: adj. 影响心理状态的；作用于精神的
words.ex: This drug is psychoactive and changes how you feel.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物是精神活性的，会改变你的感受。
words.en: affecting the mind or behavior

words.ex: He felt psychological stress before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到心理压力。
words.en: Relating to the mental and emotional state of a person.

words.tr: n. 精神病；精神错乱；思觉失调
words.ex: He showed signs of psychosis after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他表现出精神病的症状。
words.en: A severe mental disorder in which thought and emotions are so impaired that contact is lost with external reality.

words.tr: n. 心理疗法；精神疗法；
words.ex: He goes to psychotherapy every week to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他每周去接受心理疗法以感觉更好。
words.en: Psychotherapy is the treatment of mental illness by discussing someone's problems with them, rather than giving them drugs.

words.ex: He stayed in quarantine for 14 days.
words.ex_cn: 他隔离了14天。
words.en: A quarantine is a period of time during which an animal or person that might have a disease is kept away from other people or animals so that the disease cannot spread.

words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.tr: adj. 呼吸的；与呼吸有关的；
words.ex: The respiratory system helps us breathe.
words.ex_cn: 呼吸系统帮助我们呼吸。
words.en: Relating to or affecting respiration or the organs of respiration.

words.ex: Fish respire in water using gills.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用鳃在水中呼吸。
words.en: To breathe; to inhale and exhale air.

words.ex: The kitchen must be sanitary to prevent illness.
words.ex_cn: 厨房必须保持清洁以防止疾病。
words.en: relating to the conditions that affect hygiene and health, especially the supply of sewage facilities and clean drinking water

words.tr: n. 公共卫生；卫生设施；
words.ex: The city improved sanitation to keep people healthy.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了公共卫生以保障人民健康。
words.en: The conditions and processes that help maintain health and prevent disease, especially through cleanliness.

words.ex: Smallpox caused many deaths in the past.
words.ex_cn: 天花在过去导致了许多人死亡。
words.en: An acute, highly infectious, often fatal disease caused by a poxvirus and characterized by high fever and aches with subsequent widespread eruption of pimples that blister, produce pus, and form pockmarks.

words.ex: He lost his spleen in a car accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在一场车祸中失去了脾脏。
words.en: The spleen is an organ involved in the production and removal of blood cells in most vertebrates and forming part of the immune system. It can also refer to feelings of anger or spite.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.tr: adj. 外科的；外科手术的；
words.ex: The surgical team worked quickly to save the patient.
words.ex_cn: 外科团队迅速工作以挽救病人。
words.en: Relating to or used in surgery.

words.ex: Children are susceptible to colds.
words.ex_cn: 孩子容易感冒。
words.en: If you are susceptible to something or someone, you are very likely to be influenced by them.

words.tr: n. 食物；营养；维持生计
words.ex: Water and food are basic sustenance for life.
words.ex_cn: 水和食物是生命的基本生存物资。
words.en: Sustenance refers to the food and drink that people, animals, and plants need to live and stay healthy. It can also mean the means of maintaining life or supporting existence.

words.tr: n. 综合征；综合症状；典型表现；
words.ex: He was diagnosed with sleep apnea syndrome.
words.ex_cn: 他被诊断出患有睡眠呼吸暂停综合征。
words.en: A syndrome is a set of medical signs and symptoms which are correlated with each other and often associated with a particular disease or disorder.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.ex: He has tardive movements from the medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他因药物而出现迟发性运动。
words.en: Tardive refers to something that occurs or develops after a considerable delay, often used in medical contexts to describe conditions or symptoms that appear after prolonged exposure to certain triggers, such as medications.

chapters.name: Word List 5 医学（二）化学

words.ex: He takes medicine for his thyroid.
words.ex_cn: 他为甲状腺服用药物。
words.en: The thyroid is a large ductless gland in the neck that secretes hormones regulating growth and development through the rate of metabolism.

words.tr: n. 镇静剂；镇定剂；止痛药
words.ex: The doctor gave him a tranquilizer to calm down.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一种镇静剂来让他平静下来。
words.en: A tranquilizer is a drug used to reduce anxiety or tension.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with tuberculosis last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有结核病。
words.en: Tuberculosis is an infectious disease caused by the bacterium Mycobacterium tuberculosis, which primarily affects the lungs but can also affect other parts of the body.

words.tr:
n. 伤寒
adj. 伤寒性的
words.ex: He got typhoid from drinking dirty water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了脏水后得了伤寒。
words.en: Typhoid is an infectious fever caused by the bacterium Salmonella typhi, characterized by intestinal inflammation and ulceration.

words.ex: He has an ulcer from eating too much spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多辣食而得了溃疡。
words.en: An ulcer is a sore area on the skin or inside the body that is very painful and may bleed or produce a poisonous substance.

words.tr: v. 接种疫苗；预防接种
words.ex: The doctor will vaccinate the child tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天会给这个孩子接种疫苗。
words.en: To vaccinate someone is to give them a vaccine, usually by injection, to prevent them from getting a disease.

words.ex: He got a vaccine last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周打了疫苗。
words.en: A vaccine is a substance containing a virus or bacterium in a form that is not harmful, given to a person or animal to prevent them from getting the disease that the virus or bacterium causes.

words.ex: He has varicose veins on his legs.
words.ex_cn: 他的腿上有静脉曲张。
words.en: Varicose veins are veins that have become enlarged and twisted, typically appearing as bulging, blue cords running just beneath the surface of your skin. They most commonly affect the legs and feet.

words.tr: adj. 血管的；脉管的；维管的；
words.ex: The vascular system carries blood through the body.
words.ex_cn: 血管系统将血液输送到全身。
words.en: Relating to or denoting the system of vessels for conveying blood, lymph, or sap in animals and plants.

words.tr: adj. 静脉血管的；静脉的（血）
words.ex: The blood flows through venous vessels back to the heart.
words.ex_cn: 血液通过静脉血管流回心脏。
words.en: relating to the veins or the blood in them

words.ex: Eating fruits gives you vitamin C.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果可以给你维生素C。
words.en: A vitamin is one of a group of organic substances which are essential in small quantities to the nutrition of most animals and some plants, and which are present in natural foodstuffs or sometimes produced within the body.

words.ex: The viral infection made him feverish for three days.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒引起的感染让他发烧了三天。
words.en: Relating to or caused by a virus; becoming very popular by circulating quickly from person to person, especially on the internet.

words.ex: The virulent virus spread quickly through the town.
words.ex_cn: 这种剧毒的病毒迅速在小镇上传播。
words.en: A virulent disease or poison is extremely powerful and dangerous.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.ex: The baby grows in the mother's womb.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在母亲的子宫里成长。
words.en: The organ in the lower body of a woman or female mammal where offspring are conceived and in which they gestate before birth.

words.ex: He got yellow fever while traveling in Africa.
words.ex_cn: 他在非洲旅行时感染了黄热病。
words.en: Yellow fever is a serious viral disease that is transmitted by mosquitoes, primarily in tropical regions of Africa and South America. It is characterized by fever, chills, severe headache, back pain, general body aches, nausea, and vomiting. In severe cases, it can cause liver damage leading to jaundice (which gives the disease its name), bleeding, and even death.

words.ex: The can is made of aluminium.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是铝制的。
words.en: A chemical element that is a light, silver-coloured metal, used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.ex: The dentist used an amalgam to fill the cavity.
words.ex_cn: 牙医用汞合金填补了蛀牙。
words.en: An amalgam is a mixture of mercury and another metal, especially one used by dentists to fill holes in teeth. It can also refer to a mixture of different things.

words.ex: Arsenic is a poisonous element found in some water.
words.ex_cn: 砷是一种存在于某些水源中的有毒元素。
words.en: A very poisonous metallic element that has three allotropic forms; arsenic and arsenic compounds are used as herbicides and insecticides and various alloys; found in arsenopyrite and orpiment and realgar

words.tr: adj. 黄铜制的；黄铜色的；厚颜无耻的
words.ex: The brazen statue sparkled in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 这尊黄铜雕像在阳光下闪闪发光。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as brazen, you mean that they are doing something shocking or immoral in a very open way, without trying to hide it.

words.ex: The statue is made of bronze.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由青铜制成。
words.en: Bronze is a yellowish-brown metal which is a mixture of copper and tin.

words.ex: The computer uses a buffer to store data temporarily.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用缓冲区临时存储数据。
words.en: A buffer is something that prevents something else from being harmed or that reduces the impact of something.

words.ex: He drinks coffee to get caffeine.
words.ex_cn: 他喝咖啡来获取咖啡因。
words.en: A bitter alkaloid found in coffee and tea that is responsible for their stimulating effects.

words.ex: Milk has a lot of calcium.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶含有大量的钙。
words.en: A chemical element that is present in teeth and bones and is necessary for their health.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: Carbon is an element in all living things.
words.ex_cn: 碳是所有生物体中的一种元素。
words.en: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds.

words.tr: n. 胡萝卜素（等于 carotin）
words.ex: Carrots contain a lot of carotene.
words.ex_cn: 胡萝卜含有大量的胡萝卜素。
words.en: A red or yellow pigment found in carrots and other plants, which is converted into vitamin A in the liver.

words.ex: The enzyme acts as a catalyst in the reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶在反应中充当催化剂。
words.en: A catalyst is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change. In a broader sense, it can also refer to a person or thing that precipitates a change.

words.tr:
adj. 化学的；
n. 化学品；
words.ex: The lab has a chemical reaction.
words.ex_cn: 实验室里有一个化学反应。
words.en: A chemical is a substance that is used in or produced by a process involving chemistry.

words.ex: He eats eggs but watches his cholesterol.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋，但注意自己的胆固醇。
words.en: Cholesterol is a substance that exists in the cells of the body and in blood, which can cause heart disease if there is too much of it.

words.ex: He used cocaine last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚用了可卡因。
words.en: A drug obtained from the leaves of the coca plant, used as a local anesthetic and also illegally as a stimulant.

words.ex: She added cocoa to the cake batter.
words.ex_cn: 她把可可粉加到了蛋糕糊里。
words.en: Cocoa is a brown powder made from cocoa beans, used in making chocolate and in cooking.

words.tr:
n. 化合物；
adj. 复合的；混合的；
words.ex: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
words.en: A compound is a substance that consists of two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.

words.ex: Carbon dioxide makes the air warm.
words.ex_cn: 二氧化碳使空气变暖。
words.en: A compound containing two atoms of oxygen combined with another element or group.

words.ex: The ship used a dispersant to break up the oil.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船使用了分散剂来分解石油。
words.en: A dispersant is a substance that is added to a mixture to help separate the particles and prevent them from clumping together.

words.ex: Ethylene helps fruits ripen faster.
words.ex_cn: 乙烯有助于水果更快成熟。
words.en: A colorless flammable gas, C2H4, derived from natural gas and petroleum and used as a source of many organic compounds, in welding and cutting metals, and in ripening fruits.

words.ex: Formaldehyde is used in some glues.
words.ex_cn: 甲醛用于一些胶水中。
words.en: A colorless gas with a pungent smell, used as a preservative and disinfectant.

words.ex: Glycerol is used in many lotions.
words.ex_cn: 甘油被用于许多乳液中。
words.en: A colorless, sweet, viscous liquid formed as a byproduct in soap manufacture, used as an emollient and laxative, and for making explosives and antifreeze.

words.ex: He uses graphite to draw pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他用石墨画画。
words.en: Graphite is a soft, black form of carbon that is used in pencils and as a lubricant.

words.ex: The balloon is filled with helium.
words.ex_cn: 气球里充满了氦气。
words.en: Helium is a chemical element with the symbol He and atomic number 2. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless, non-toxic, inert, monatomic gas, the first in the noble gas group in the periodic table. Its boiling point is the lowest among all the elements.

words.ex: The doctor checked his hemoglobin level.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他的血红素水平。
words.en: Hemoglobin is the protein molecule in red blood cells that carries oxygen from the lungs to the body's tissues and returns carbon dioxide from the tissues back to the lungs.

words.ex: The herpesvirus causes cold sores on the lips.
words.ex_cn: 单纯疱疹病毒会导致嘴唇上长水泡。
words.en: Any of a group of DNA viruses that cause diseases in humans and animals, including herpes simplex and chickenpox.

words.ex: Hormones control growth and mood in the body.
words.ex_cn: 荷尔蒙控制身体的生长和情绪。
words.en: A hormone is a chemical substance produced in the body that controls and regulates the activity of certain cells or organs.

words.ex: The car burns hydrocarbon fuel.
words.ex_cn: 汽车燃烧碳氢化合物燃料。
words.en: A hydrocarbon is an organic compound consisting entirely of hydrogen and carbon.

words.ex: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
words.ex_cn: 氢是最轻的元素。
words.en: Hydrogen is a chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1. With a standard atomic weight of 1.008, hydrogen is the lightest element in the periodic table.

words.ex: Farmers use insecticide to kill bugs on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的害虫。
words.en: A substance used for killing insects.

words.ex: Your body metabolize food to get energy.
words.ex_cn: 你的身体通过新陈代谢食物来获取能量。
words.en: To metabolize means to process a substance in the body by metabolism.

words.ex: Methane is a gas that comes from cows and landfills.
words.ex_cn: 甲烷是一种来自牛和垃圾填埋场的气体。
words.en: A colorless, odorless flammable gas which is the main constituent of natural gas. It is the simplest member of the alkane series of hydrocarbons.

words.ex: Rock contains many minerals.
words.ex_cn: 岩石中含有许多矿物。
words.en: A mineral is a solid substance that occurs naturally and has a specific chemical composition and structure.

words.ex: Water is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom in a molecule.
words.ex_cn: 水由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成一个分子。
words.en: A molecule is the smallest particle in a chemical element or compound that has the chemical properties of that element or compound. Molecules are made up of atoms that are held together by chemical bonds.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.ex: DNA is made of many nucleotides.
words.ex_cn: DNA由许多核苷酸组成。
words.en: A nucleotide is one of the structural components, or building blocks, of DNA and RNA. A nucleotide consists of a base (one of four chemicals: adenine, thymine, guanine, and cytosine) plus a molecule of sugar and one of phosphoric acid.

words.tr: n. 赭土；[矿物] 赭石；赭色
words.ex: The artist used ocher to paint the desert.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家用赭石色画沙漠。
words.en: A natural earth pigment containing hydrated iron oxide, which ranges in color from yellow to deep orange or brown.

words.tr: n. [有化] 寡糖，[有化] 低聚糖
words.ex: The baby digests oligosaccharide in mother's milk.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿消化母乳中的低聚糖。
words.en: A carbohydrate whose molecules are composed of a relatively small number of monosaccharide units.

words.ex: The miners dug deep to find iron ore.
words.ex_cn: 矿工们深入地下寻找铁矿石。
words.en: Ore is rock or earth from which metal can be obtained.

words.ex: Rust is an oxide of iron.
words.ex_cn: 铁锈是铁的氧化物。
words.en: An oxide is a chemical compound that contains at least one oxygen atom and one other element in its chemical formula.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: Ozone is a form of oxygen that has three atoms in each molecule, and it is a pale blue gas with a pungent smell. It is found in the Earth's atmosphere and absorbs ultraviolet radiation, which is harmful to living organisms.

words.tr: n. 微粒；大气尘；微粒物质；空气中微小颗粒（particulate 的复数形式）
words.ex: The air has many particulates after the fire.
words.ex_cn: 火灾之后，空气中有很多颗粒物。
words.en: Particulates are tiny particles of a substance, especially those that are produced by vehicles and are harmful when breathed in.

words.ex: Farmers use pesticide to kill insects on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的昆虫。
words.en: A pesticide is a chemical substance used to kill pests, especially insects, that damage crops or are harmful to human health.

words.ex: The car runs on petroleum.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车使用石油运行。
words.en: A naturally occurring, yellow-to-black liquid found in geological formations beneath the Earth's surface, which is commonly refined into various types of fuels.

words.ex: The plant needs phosphate to grow well.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要磷酸盐才能良好生长。
words.en: A phosphate is a salt or ester of phosphoric acid, containing the anion PO₄³⁻ or the group —PO₄.

words.ex: The pigment in leaves changes color in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 叶子中的色素在秋天会变色。
words.en: A pigment is a substance that gives something a particular color.

words.tr: n. 钚（放射性化学元素）
words.ex: Plutonium is used in nuclear weapons.
words.ex_cn: 钚用于核武器。
words.en: A radioactive metallic element used especially as a fuel in nuclear reactors and as an explosive in nuclear weapons.

words.ex: The factory releases a pollutant into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河里排放一种污染物。
words.en: A pollutant is a substance that pollutes something, especially air, water, or soil.

words.tr: n. 多形体；多晶型物；同质异像体；多态生物，多态无机物；多型核细胞
words.ex: The insect is a polymorph with different shapes.
words.ex_cn: 这种昆虫是一种具有不同形态的多态生物。
words.en: A polymorph is a substance or organism that can exist in several different forms or shapes.

words.ex: Bananas have a lot of potassium.
words.ex_cn: 香蕉含有大量的钾。
words.en: A soft silver-white reactive metal of the alkali metal group, occurring principally in the form of salts in seawater and in minerals such as sylvite and carnallite.

words.ex: The precipitation increased last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周降水增加了。
words.en: Precipitation is rain, snow, sleet, or hail — any kind of weather condition where something's falling from the sky.

words.ex: Bread often contains a preservative to last longer.
words.ex_cn: 面包中常含有防腐剂以延长保质期。
words.en: A preservative is a chemical that is added to substances such as food, wood, or medicine to prevent them from decaying or spoiling.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: The scientist used a pseudomer to simulate the molecule.
words.ex_cn: 科学家使用伪聚体来模拟分子。
words.en: A pseudomer is a chemical compound that appears to be an isomer of another compound but differs in its molecular structure.

words.ex: The house has high levels of radon.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的氡气含量很高。
words.en: Radon is a chemical element with the symbol Rn and atomic number 86. It is a radioactive, colorless, odorless, tasteless noble gas, occurring naturally as an indirect decay product of uranium or thorium.

words.ex: The ribosome makes proteins in the cell.
words.ex_cn: 核糖体在细胞中制造蛋白质。
words.en: A ribosome is a minute particle consisting of RNA and associated proteins, found in large numbers in the cytoplasm of living cells. They bind messenger RNA and transfer RNA to synthesize polypeptides and proteins.

words.ex: He adds sodium to his food for taste.
words.ex_cn: 他为了味道在食物里加钠。
words.en: Sodium is a soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal. Sodium is an alkali metal, being in group 1 of the periodic table, because it has a single electron in its outer shell that it readily donates, creating a positively charged ion—the Na⁺ cation.

words.ex: The volcano released sulfur into the air.
words.ex_cn: 火山向空气中释放了硫。
words.en: Sulfur is a pale yellow, odorless, brittle solid, which is insoluble in water but soluble in carbon disulfide.

words.ex: He found uranium in the old rock sample.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧岩石样本中发现了铀。
words.en: A heavy, silvery-white metallic element, radioactive and toxic, used as a fuel in nuclear reactors and in the manufacture of nuclear weapons.

words.ex: The children played near the cinder pile after the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在火堆后的煤渣堆旁玩耍。
words.en: A cinder is a small piece of partly burnt coal or wood that has stopped giving off flames but still has combustible matter in it.

words.ex: The char cleaned the office every morning.
words.ex_cn: 女清洁工每天早上打扫办公室。
words.en: To char is to burn something so that it becomes black or to work temporarily in a job.

words.tr: v. 结晶；定形；（使）具体化；变明确
words.ex: The idea began to crystallize after many talks.
words.ex_cn: 经过多次讨论，这个想法开始明朗起来。
words.en: To crystallize means to cause something to form into crystals or to become clear and definite in form.

chapters.name: Word List 6 动物学 人类学

words.tr: n. 变色龙，变色蜥，安乐蜥
words.ex: An anole lizard climbs the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一只安乐蜥爬上了树。
words.en: A small lizard, especially one of the genus Anolis, native to the Americas, known for its ability to change color.

words.ex: Anopheles mosquitoes carry malaria.
words.ex_cn: 按蚊传播疟疾。
words.en: A genus of mosquitoes that are known to transmit malaria to humans.

words.ex: The ant moved its antenna to feel the ground.
words.ex_cn: 蚂蚁用它的触角感知地面。
words.en: An antenna is a device that sends and receives radio or television signals. In biology, it refers to the long, thin sensory appendages on the heads of insects and crustaceans.

words.ex: The ape climbed slowly up the tree.
words.ex_cn: 这只猿慢慢爬上了树。
words.en: An ape is a large primate that does not have a tail, for example a chimpanzee or gorilla.

words.ex: The avian species flew south for winter.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟类飞往南方过冬。
words.en: Relating to birds.

words.tr: n. 用两足运动，二足性
words.ex: Humans show bipedalism by walking on two legs.
words.ex_cn: 人类通过用两条腿走路表现出双足行走。
words.en: Bipedalism is the condition of using two legs for walking.

words.ex: Lions are carnivores that eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是吃肉的食肉动物。
words.en: A carnivore is an animal that eats the flesh of other animals.

words.ex: The caterpillar is eating leaves on the tree.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫正在树上吃叶子。
words.en: A caterpillar is a small, worm-like animal that eventually develops into a butterfly or moth.

words.tr: n. 变色龙；见风使舵的人
words.ex: The chameleon changes color to hide.
words.ex_cn: 变色龙改变颜色来隐藏自己。
words.en: A chameleon is a type of lizard that can change the color of its skin in order to blend in with its surroundings.

words.ex: The condor flies high above the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 秃鹰在群山之上翱翔。
words.en: A condor is a very large bird of prey that lives in the mountains of South America and California.

words.ex: The child loves to watch dinosaurs on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子喜欢在电视上看恐龙。
words.en: A dinosaur is a type of reptile that lived millions of years ago, known for its large size and often extinct species.

words.ex: The forest is home to a rich fauna.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是丰富动物群的家园。
words.en: The animals of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.

words.tr:
n. 刚长齐羽毛学飞的幼鸟
adj. 新形成的；无经验的
v. 羽毛长成；用羽毛盖上；装上羽毛；“fledge”的现在分词
words.ex: The fledgling bird tried to fly for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这只幼鸟第一次尝试飞翔。
words.en: A fledgling is a young bird that has just grown its feathers and is learning to fly. It can also refer to a person or organization that is new and inexperienced.

words.ex: The gorilla sits quietly in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 大猩猩静静地坐在森林里。
words.en: A gorilla is a large, powerful ape that is native to the forests of central Africa. Gorillas are the largest living primates and are closely related to humans.

words.ex: The hamster runs on its wheel at night.
words.ex_cn: 仓鼠晚上在轮子上跑步。
words.en: A hamster is a small furry animal with large cheeks for carrying food, which is often kept as a pet.

words.ex: The deer is a herbivore.
words.ex_cn: 鹿是食草动物。
words.en: An herbivore is an animal that gets its energy from eating plants, and only plants.

words.ex: He bought a fresh herring at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一条新鲜的青鱼。
words.en: A herring is a long silver-colored fish. Herring live in large groups in the sea.

words.ex: The hippo is sleeping in the river.
words.ex_cn: 河马正在河里睡觉。
words.en: A hippopotamus is a large, mostly herbivorous, semiaquatic mammal native to sub-Saharan Africa.

words.ex: The jellyfish is an invertebrate.
words.ex_cn: 水母是一种无脊椎动物。
words.en: An invertebrate is an animal that does not have a backbone or spinal column.

words.tr: n. 哺乳；哺乳期；授乳（形容词 lactational）；分泌乳汁
words.ex: The mother is experiencing lactation after giving birth.
words.ex_cn: 这位母亲在分娩后正在哺乳。
words.en: The secretion of milk by the mammary glands.

words.ex: The butterfly starts as a larva.
words.ex_cn: 蝴蝶从幼虫开始。
words.en: An insect in the stage of development when it has just come out of an egg and before it changes into its adult form.

words.tr:
v. 加酵母；使发酵；影响
n. 酵素；酵母；潜移默化的影响
words.ex: She uses yeast to leaven the bread.
words.ex_cn: 她用酵母使面包发酵。
words.en: Leaven is a substance, typically yeast, that is used in dough to make it rise. It can also refer to something that modifies or lightens a situation or atmosphere.

words.ex: The child caught a lepidopter in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在花园里抓到一只鳞翅类昆虫。
words.en: Lepidopter refers to any of numerous insects of the order Lepidoptera, including butterflies and moths, characterized by four large, scale-covered wings that are typically brightly colored.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his livestock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的家畜。
words.en: Livestock are animals such as cattle and sheep which are kept on a farm.

words.ex: He bought a fresh lobster at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一只新鲜的龙虾。
words.en: A lobster is a sea creature with a hard shell, two large claws, and eight legs, or the flesh of this animal eaten as food.

words.ex: A dog is a mammal.
words.ex_cn: 狗是一种哺乳动物。
words.en: A mammal is a type of animal that feeds its young with milk produced by the mother's body. Mammals are warm-blooded and usually have hair or fur.

words.ex: The microbe causes sickness.
words.ex_cn: 这种微生物会引起疾病。
words.en: A microbe is a very small living thing, which you can only see if you use a microscope. Some microbes can cause diseases.

words.ex: A mosquito bit my arm last night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蚊子昨晚咬了我的胳膊。
words.en: A mosquito is a small flying insect that bites people and animals in order to feed on their blood. Some mosquitoes can transmit diseases.

words.ex: A moth flew into the room through the window.
words.ex_cn: 一只蛾子从窗户飞进了房间。
words.en: A moth is an insect with wings that is related to the butterfly. Moths are often attracted to light and are mostly active at night.

words.ex: The neuron sends signals to the brain.
words.ex_cn: 神经元向大脑发送信号。
words.en: A neuron is a cell that is specialized to conduct nerve impulses.

words.tr: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物；依赖他人过活者；
words.ex: The parasite lives inside the host's body.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的体内。
words.en: A parasite is an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.

words.ex: The pelvis supports the spine and protects internal organs.
words.ex_cn: 骨盆支撑脊柱并保护内脏。
words.en: The pelvis is the large bony structure near the base of the spine to which the hind limbs or legs are attached in humans and many other vertebrates.

words.ex: Plankton float in the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 浮游生物漂浮在海洋中。
words.en: Plankton are the diverse collection of organisms found in water (or air) that are unable to propel themselves against a current (or wind).
