words.en: A staple is a basic food that is eaten regularly and in such quantities that it constitutes a dominant portion of a standard diet for a given people, supplying a large fraction of energy needs and generally forming a significant proportion of the intake of other nutrients as well.

words.ex: The mechanic checked the throttle on the car engine.
words.ex_cn: 机械师检查了汽车发动机的节流阀。
words.en: To throttle someone means to kill or injure them by squeezing their throat or tightening something around it and preventing them from breathing. A throttle is a device that controls the amount of fuel going into an engine.

words.ex: The workers dug a trench to lay the pipe.
words.ex_cn: 工人们挖了一条沟来铺设管道。
words.en: A trench is a long, narrow ditch. In warfare, trenches are dug by troops to provide shelter from enemy fire.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: He looks at the stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer, containing an arrangement of lenses, or of curved mirrors and lenses, by which rays of light are collected and focused and the resulting image magnified.

words.ex: She carefully removed the wrapper from the gift.
words.ex_cn: 她小心地从礼物上拆下包装纸。
words.en: A wrapper is a piece of paper, plastic, or thin metal which covers and protects something that you buy, especially food.

chapters.name: Word List 12 社会事物（一）称呼

words.ex: He is the recipient of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个奖项的接受者。
words.en: A recipient is a person who receives something.

words.ex: He posted an anonymous comment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在网上发布了一条匿名评论。
words.en: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

words.ex: He was known as an apologist for the controversial theory.
words.ex_cn: 他以该争议理论的辩护者而闻名。
words.en: An apologist is someone who defends or justifies a particular idea, person, or institution, especially in a way that is considered to be too uncritical or forgiving.

words.ex: The arbitrator helped the two sides reach an agreement.
words.ex_cn: 仲裁员帮助双方达成了协议。
words.en: An arbitrator is a person who has been officially chosen to make a decision between two people or groups who do not agree.

words.ex: The artisan makes handmade pottery.
words.ex_cn: 这位工匠制作手工陶器。
words.en: An artisan is someone who makes things by hand, especially using traditional methods.

words.tr: n. 律师；辩护律师；代理人
words.ex: The attorney helped the man with his case.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助那个人处理了他的案件。
words.en: An attorney is a lawyer who is qualified to represent a client in court.

words.ex: He claims authorship of the novel.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己是这部小说的作者。
words.en: The state or fact of being the writer of a book, article, or document, or the creator of a work of art.

words.ex: The bandit stole money from the bank.
words.ex_cn: 强盗从银行偷了钱。
words.en: A bandit is a person who robs people, especially one of a group of people who attack travelers.

words.tr: n. 恩人；捐助者；赠送者
words.ex: The benefactor gave money to the school.
words.ex_cn: 资助人捐钱给学校。
words.en: A benefactor is a person who gives money or other help to a person or cause.

words.ex: The burglar broke into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 窃贼在夜里闯入了房子。
words.en: A burglar is a person who illegally enters buildings and steals things.

words.tr: n. 制图员；地图绘制员
words.ex: The cartographer drew a map of the island.
words.ex_cn: 这位制图师画了一张岛屿的地图。
words.en: A cartographer is a person who draws or produces maps.

words.ex: The celebrity smiled at the fans outside the theater.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人向剧院外的粉丝微笑。
words.en: A celebrity is a famous person, especially in entertainment or sports.

words.ex: The chef cooked a delicious dinner for the guests.
words.ex_cn: 主厨为客人做了一顿美味的晚餐。
words.en: A chef is a professional cook, typically the chief cook in a restaurant or hotel.

words.ex: He works in a clerical job at the office.
words.ex_cn: 他在办公室做文书工作。
words.en: Clerical means relating to work that is done in an office, especially work that involves keeping records or accounts. It can also refer to the clergy or the religious leaders of a church.

words.tr: n. 喜剧演员；滑稽人物；
words.ex: The comedian made everyone laugh with his jokes.
words.ex_cn: 这位喜剧演员用他的笑话逗得大家大笑。
words.en: A comedian is a person whose job is to make people laugh by telling jokes or funny stories.

words.ex: He is a consultant for a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家大公司的顾问。
words.en: A consultant is a person who gives expert advice to a person or organization on a particular subject.

words.tr: n. 承包商；承包人；订约人
words.ex: The contractor fixed the roof last week.
words.ex_cn: 承包商上周修好了屋顶。
words.en: A contractor is a person or company that undertakes a contract to provide materials or labor to perform a service or do a job.

words.ex: The courier delivered the letter quickly.
words.ex_cn: 信使迅速送来了这封信。
words.en: A courier is a person or company that delivers messages, packages, and mail.

words.ex: The distributor delivers snacks to local stores.
words.ex_cn: 这家经销商将零食配送到本地商店。
words.en: A distributor is a company or person that supplies goods to shops or other businesses, or a device that sends out electricity to the spark plugs in an engine.

words.ex: The donor gave money to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 捐赠者向医院捐了钱。
words.en: A donor is a person or organization that gives something, especially money, to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: He became a dropout after failing math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试不及格后退学了。
words.en: A dropout is a person who leaves school or college before they have finished their studies, especially because they are not interested in continuing.

words.ex: The emperor ruled the country for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这位皇帝统治这个国家很多年。
words.en: A male sovereign ruler of an empire.

words.tr: n. 企业家；创业者；承包人；
words.ex: He is an entrepreneur who started a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位创办了小型咖啡店的企业家。
words.en: An entrepreneur is a person who organizes and operates a business or businesses, taking on greater than normal financial risks in order to do so.

words.ex: His entrepreneurship helped start a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他的企业家精神帮助创办了一家小企业。
words.en: Entrepreneurship is the activity of setting up a business or businesses, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit.

words.tr: n. 死刑执行人；刽子手
words.ex: The executioner carried out the sentence quietly.
words.ex_cn: 刽子手安静地执行了判决。
words.en: An executioner is a person who carries out a death sentence on a legally condemned person.

words.ex: He eats gourmet food at a fancy restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家高档餐厅吃精致美食。
words.en: A gourmet is someone who knows a lot about food and cooking, and who enjoys eating high-quality food.

words.ex: The gymnast flips in the air and lands softly.
words.ex_cn: 体操运动员在空中翻转并轻柔落地。
words.en: A gymnast is a person who is trained in or skilled in gymnastics, especially competitive gymnastics.

words.ex: She visited a gynecologist for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 她去看妇科医生做检查。
words.en: A gynecologist is a doctor who specializes in women's health, particularly the health of the female reproductive system.

words.ex: The historian wrote a book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 这位历史学家写了一本关于古罗马的书。
words.en: A historian is a person who studies or writes about history; an expert in history.

words.ex: The hypnotist made the man sleep with his voice.
words.ex_cn: 催眠师用他的声音让那个人睡着了。
words.en: A hypnotist is a person who uses hypnosis to influence others.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.ex: The tenant pays rent every month.
words.ex_cn: 房客每个月支付租金。
words.en: A tenant is a person who rents land or property from a landlord.

words.ex: Victor won the race last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 维克多上周日赢得了比赛。
words.en: A victor is someone who wins a competition, battle, or game.

chapters.name: Word List 12 社会事物（一）建筑

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.ex: The library keeps old newspapers in an archive.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆把旧报纸保存在档案馆里。
words.en: A collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.tr:
n. 巴洛克式；
adj. 巴洛克式的；
words.ex: The church has a baroque style with gold decorations.
words.ex_cn: 这座教堂具有巴洛克风格，装饰有金色元素。
words.en: Baroque is a style of architecture, music, and art that was common in Europe in the 17th and early 18th centuries, characterized by ornate detail.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.tr:
n. 扶墙；拱壁
v. 支持
words.ex: The old wall needs a buttress to stay standing.
words.ex_cn: 这面旧墙需要一个支撑物来保持不倒。
words.en: A buttress is a structure built against or projecting from a wall which serves to support or reinforce the wall. As a verb, to buttress means to support or strengthen something.

words.ex: The cathedral has tall towers and stained glass windows.
words.ex_cn: 这座大教堂有高高的塔楼和彩绘玻璃窗。
words.en: A cathedral is a very large and important church which has a bishop in charge of it.

words.tr: n. 房间；室；腔；大会议室；
words.ex: He sat in the chamber and waited quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在房间里安静地等待。
words.en: A chamber is a large room, especially one that is used for formal or public events.

words.ex: Education is the cornerstone of a strong society.
words.ex_cn: 教育是强大社会的基石。
words.en: A cornerstone is an important quality or feature on which a particular thing depends or is based.

words.ex: The Pantheon is an ancient temple in Rome.
words.ex_cn: 万神庙是罗马的一座古代神庙。
words.en: A pantheon is a group of particularly respected, famous, or important people, or a temple dedicated to all the gods of a particular polytheistic religion.

words.ex: The tectonic plates move slowly over time.
words.ex_cn: 板块随着时间缓慢移动。
words.en: Relating to the structure of the earth's crust and the large-scale processes which take place within it.

words.ex: The pipe is tubular and long.
words.ex_cn: 这根管道是管状的，很长。
words.en: Something that is tubular is shaped like a tube or is made of tubes.

words.ex: He crossed the threshold of adulthood at 18.
words.ex_cn: 他在18岁时进入了成年的起始点。
words.en: The threshold of something is the point at which it begins or changes.

chapters.name: Word List 13 社会事物（二）交通

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；堵塞的； v. “congest” 的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The road was congested with cars during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段，这条路被汽车挤满了。
words.en: If a place is congested, it is extremely crowded and blocked with traffic or people.

words.ex: He decided to embark on a new career.
words.ex_cn: 他决定从事一份新职业。
words.en: To embark on something means to start it, especially something new, difficult, or exciting.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: He drives an automobile to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: A vehicle that is powered by an engine and is used for carrying passengers on roads.

words.tr: v. 制动（brake 的现在分词）；刹车；
words.ex: The driver started braking when he saw the red light.
words.ex_cn: 司机看到红灯时开始刹车。
words.en: The action of slowing down or stopping a vehicle by using a brake.

words.ex: The pedestrian crossed the street at the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 行人在斑马线处过马路。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking in a city, town, or village, especially along a pavement or in a pedestrian area.

words.ex: The fish swim near the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在珊瑚礁附近游动。
words.en: A reef is a long line of rocks or sand, the top of which is just above or just below the surface of the sea.

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.tr: n. 轿子；小轿车；厢式轿车
words.ex: The man rode in a sedan carried by two servants.
words.ex_cn: 这个人坐在两个仆人抬的轿子里。
words.en: A sedan is a type of car that has a closed body and a separate trunk, typically seating four or more people.

words.tr: n. 统舱；舵效；操舵；驾驶；管理；士官的二等室
words.ex: He traveled in steerage on the old ship.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐旧船的三等舱旅行。
words.en: The part of a ship providing accommodations for passengers with the cheapest tickets.

words.ex: The jet flies at supersonic speed.
words.ex_cn: 这架喷气式飞机以超音速飞行。
words.en: relating to speeds that are faster than the speed of sound

words.ex: The rain wiped the windshield clean.
words.ex_cn: 雨水把挡风玻璃冲干净了。
words.en: The windshield is the window at the front of a vehicle, through which the driver and passengers can see the road ahead.

chapters.name: Word List 13 社会事物（二）其他事物

words.ex: I bought fresh bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 我从面包房买了新鲜面包。
words.en: A bakery is a place where bread, cakes, and pastries are made or sold.

words.ex: He poured water into a wooden barrel.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进一个木桶里。
words.en: A barrel is a large, round container for liquids or food, typically made of wood or metal.

words.tr: n. 编篮技艺；篓编织品
words.ex: He makes basketry from woven reeds.
words.ex_cn: 他用编织的芦苇制作篮子。
words.en: The craft or process of making baskets.

words.ex: He drinks a cold beverage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝一杯冷饮。
words.en: A drink, especially one other than water; a liquid for drinking.

words.ex: He does bookkeeping for his small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的小商店做记账。
words.en: Bookkeeping is the job or activity of keeping an accurate record of the money that is spent and received by a business or other organization.

words.tr:
n. 飞去来器；回旋镖；回力镖
v. 自食其果；害人反害己
words.ex: He threw the boomerang and it came back to him.
words.ex_cn: 他扔出了回旋镖，它又飞回到他身边。
words.en: A boomerang is a curved piece of wood which comes back to you if you throw it correctly. It is used by Australian Aborigines for hunting and for sport.

words.ex: He bought a hot dog from a food booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个小吃亭买了个热狗。
words.en: A booth is a small area separated from a larger public area by screens or thin walls where, for example, people can make a phone call or vote in private.

words.ex: The slow computer is a bottleneck in our work.
words.ex_cn: 这台慢电脑是我们工作的瓶颈。
words.en: A bottleneck is a point of congestion in a system that occurs when workloads arrive too quickly for the system to handle. In terms of traffic, it refers to a narrow section of road or a junction that impedes traffic flow.

words.ex: She bought a bouquet of flowers for her mom.
words.ex_cn: 她为妈妈买了一束花。
words.en: A bouquet is a bunch of flowers that is attractively arranged, especially one that is given to someone as a present.

words.ex: The brewery makes fresh beer every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家啤酒厂每天生产新鲜的啤酒。
words.en: A brewery is a place where beer is made commercially.

words.tr:
n. 盐水；卤水；咸水；海水
v. 用盐水处理
words.ex: She put the fish in brine to preserve it.
words.ex_cn: 她把鱼放在盐水中腌制以保存它。
words.en: Brine is water that contains a high concentration of salt, used especially for preserving food.

words.tr:
n. 浮标；浮筒
v. 使浮起；支撑；鼓励
words.ex: The buoy floats on the water.
words.ex_cn: 浮标漂浮在水面上。
words.en: A buoy is a floating object that is anchored in water to mark a location, warn of danger, or indicate a navigational channel.

words.tr:
n. 半身像；胸部；搜捕
v. 打碎；搜捕
adj. 破产的；打碎的
words.ex: The museum has a marble bust of the ancient king.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一座古代国王的大理石半身像。
words.en: A bust is a sculpture of a person's head, shoulders, and chest. As a verb, to bust means to break something, to arrest someone, or to go bankrupt.

words.ex: The sailors slept in the cabin during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 水手们在风暴期间睡在船舱里。
words.en: A cabin is a small room or compartment, especially one on a ship or an aircraft.

words.tr:
n. 藏物处；隐藏物；
v. 匿藏；
words.ex: The hunters found a cache of food under the rocks.
words.ex_cn: 猎人们在石头下发现了一个食物藏匿处。
words.en: A cache is a hidden store of things such as weapons or a supply of food.

words.tr: n. 摄像放像机；（便携式）摄像机
words.ex: He bought a camcorder to record his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个摄像机来记录他的旅行。
words.en: A camcorder is an electronic device that combines a video camera and a video recorder into one unit, typically used for recording video with sound.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.ex: The tent has a waterproof canopy.
words.ex_cn: 这顶帐篷有一个防水天篷。
words.en: A canopy is a layer of something that spreads out and covers an area, especially the branches and leaves that spread out at the top of trees in a forest.

words.ex: He paints on a canvas with oil colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用油画颜料在帆布上作画。
words.en: A strong, coarse unbleached cloth made from hemp, flax, cotton, or a similar yarn, used to make items such as sails and tents and as a surface for oil painting.

words.ex: The government imposed censorship on the news.
words.ex_cn: 政府对新闻实施了审查。
words.en: Censorship is the censoring of books, plays, films, or reports, especially by government officials, because they are considered immoral or secret in some way.

words.ex: The government does a census every ten years.
words.ex_cn: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查。
words.en: A census is an official count or survey of a population, typically recording various details of individuals.

words.tr: n. 通勤者；经常往返者；
words.ex: He is a commuter who takes the train to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每天乘火车上班的通勤者。
words.en: A commuter is someone who travels a long distance to work every day.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.ex: The bottle has a cork stopper.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子有一个软木塞。
words.en: Cork is a light, porous material obtained from the bark of the cork oak tree, used especially for making stoppers for bottles.

words.tr: n. 洗涤剂；洗衣粉；去垢剂；
words.ex: She uses detergent to wash the clothes.
words.ex_cn: 她用洗涤剂洗衣服。
words.en: A detergent is a substance that is used for cleaning things, especially clothes and dishes.

words.ex: She missed the quiet domesticity of her childhood home.
words.ex_cn: 她怀念童年家园的宁静家庭生活。
words.en: Domesticity refers to home or family life, especially the activities and duties involved in running a household.

words.ex: The boat is made of fiberglass.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船是用玻璃纤维制成的。
words.en: A material consisting of extremely fine filaments of glass that are combined in yarn and woven into fabrics, used in textiles and for insulation and reinforcement of plastics.

words.tr:
n. 漏斗；
v. 输送；
words.ex: He poured the oil through a funnel.
words.ex_cn: 他把油通过漏斗倒了进去。
words.en: A funnel is an object with a wide, circular top and a narrow tube at the bottom, used for pouring liquids or powders into containers with small openings.

words.tr: v. 由于保险丝烧断而电路不通；熔接；结合；
words.ex: The light went out because the fuse blew.
words.ex_cn: 灯灭了，因为保险丝烧断了。
words.en: A fuse is a safety device consisting of a strip of wire that melts and breaks an electric circuit if the current exceeds a safe level. As a verb, it means to join or blend to form a single entity.

words.ex: The helicopter flew over the city.
words.ex_cn: 直升机飞过了城市。
words.en: A helicopter is a type of aircraft that derives both lift and propulsion from one or more sets of horizontally revolving overhead rotors. It is capable of moving vertically and horizontally, the direction of motion being controlled by the pitch of the rotor blades.

words.tr: n. 意识形态；思想体系；
words.ex: His ideology is based on equality and justice.
words.ex_cn: 他的意识形态基于平等与正义。
words.en: An ideology is a set of beliefs, especially one held by a particular group, that influences the way people think and behave.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: He bought insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了保险。
words.en: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

words.tr: adj. 讲究礼仪的；隆重的
words.ex: He gave a ceremonious speech at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他在婚礼上发表了一篇庄重的演讲。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as ceremonious, you mean that they are very formal or polite.

chapters.name: Word List 13 社会事物（二）饮食

words.ex: She braised the beef until it was tender.
words.ex_cn: 她把牛肉慢炖至软烂。
words.en: To braise is to cook food slowly in a small amount of liquid in a closed container.

words.ex: The soup was palatable after adding salt.
words.ex_cn: 加了盐后，汤变得可口美味了。
words.en: If you describe food or drink as palatable, you mean that it tastes pleasant.

words.ex: The restaurant caters to vegetarians.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅满足素食者的需求。
words.en: To cater means to provide food and drink at an event, often as a business service, or to provide what is needed or wanted by a particular person or group.

words.ex: He ate caviar at the fancy restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他在高档餐厅吃了鱼子酱。
words.en: Caviar is the salted eggs of a large fish, especially a sturgeon, and is considered a delicacy.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.ex: He found a clam on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上发现了一只蛤。
words.en: A clam is a type of shellfish with a shell in two parts that can open and close. Clams can be eaten as food.

words.ex: He has a culinary degree from a famous school.
words.ex_cn: 他从一所著名学校获得了烹饪学位。
words.en: Relating to cooking or the kitchen.

words.ex: He follows a dietary plan to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循一种饮食计划来保持健康。
words.en: Relating to the diet or the kinds of food that a person, animal, or community habitually eats.

words.ex: The stomach digests food into nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 胃将食物消化成营养物质。
words.en: To digest means to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances that can be absorbed by the body. It can also mean to understand or assimilate information. As a noun, it refers to a compilation or summary of information.

words.ex: They dine at 7 every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上七点进餐。
words.en: To dine means to eat dinner.

words.ex: He kneaded the dough for bread.
words.ex_cn: 他揉了做面包的生面团。
words.en: Dough is a thick, malleable mixture of flour and liquid, used for baking into bread or pastry. It can also informally refer to money.

words.tr: adj. 可食用的；可以吃的；
words.ex: These mushrooms are edible and safe to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这些蘑菇是可食用的，安全可以吃。
words.en: Fit to be eaten as food.

words.ex: The baby ingests milk every few hours.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿每隔几小时喝奶。
words.en: To ingest means to take food, drink, or another substance into your body, usually by swallowing.

words.ex: He eats oatmeal for breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃燕麦片当早餐。
words.en: Oatmeal is a type of coarse flour made of hulled oat grains that have either been milled or steel-cut. Ground oats are also called white oats. Steel-cut oats are known as coarse oatmeal, Irish oatmeal, or pinhead oats.

words.tr: phrase. 加工食品；经过工业处理的食品
words.ex: He avoids processed food because it is unhealthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃加工食品，因为它不健康。
words.en: Processed food refers to food items that have been altered from their natural state for safety reasons or convenience, often through canning, freezing, refrigeration, dehydration, or aseptic processing.

words.ex: His recipe for success is hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的秘诀是努力工作和耐心。
words.en: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a set of instructions that tell you how to cook something.

words.ex: He eats a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃三明治。
words.en: A sandwich consists of two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.ex: He adds sweetener to his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他往咖啡里加甜味剂。
words.en: A sweetener is a substance used to sweeten food or drink, especially one that does not contain sugar.

chapters.name: Word List 14 社会事物（三）文书

words.ex: The word 'boldface' is written in boldface in this sentence.
words.ex_cn: 这个词 'boldface' 在这句话中用粗体写成。
words.en: Boldface is a typeface that is thicker and darker than the regular typeface, used to emphasize text.

words.ex: He showed his portfolio to the art teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向美术老师展示了他作品集。
words.en: A portfolio is a set of pictures by someone, or photographs of examples of their work, which they use when entering competitions or applying for work.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.tr: phrase. 卡片目录（用于图书馆中按卡片索引图书的系统）
words.ex: He found the book using the card catalogue.
words.ex_cn: 他通过卡片目录找到了这本书。
words.en: A card catalogue is a system for organizing information about the books and other materials in a library, consisting of cards with information on them that are arranged in a particular order.

words.ex: The Magna Carta is an old charter of rights.
words.ex_cn: 《大宪章》是一份古老的权力宪章。
words.en: A charter is a formal document describing the rights, aims, or principles of an organization or group of people.

words.tr:
n. 编年史；年代记
v. 按时间顺序记录
words.ex: He writes a chronicle of his daily life.
words.ex_cn: 他记录自己每天的生活。
words.en: A chronicle is a historical account of events arranged in chronological order, typically without analysis or interpretation.

words.tr: n. 年代学；年表；按年代次序的排列
words.ex: He wrote the chronology of ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他写了古罗马的年代顺序。
words.en: Chronology is the arrangement of events or dates in the order of their occurrence.

words.ex: He read a compendium of math rules.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本数学规则的汇编。
words.en: A compendium is a short but complete collection of information, usually in a book.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.ex: The contraction of the muscle helps you move your arm.
words.ex_cn: 肌肉的收缩帮助你移动手臂。
words.en: A contraction is a process of becoming smaller or shorter, or a word that is made shorter by leaving out some letters.

words.ex: He signed a contractual agreement last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周签署了一份合同协议。
words.en: Relating to or part of a contract.

words.ex: It is a convention to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.ex_cn: 见面时握手是一种习俗。
words.en: A convention is a large meeting of an organization or political group, or a way of behaving that is considered to be correct or polite by most people in a society.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.tr:
n. 社论；
adj. 编辑的；
words.ex: The newspaper published an editorial about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 报纸发表了一篇关于气候变化的社论。
words.en: An editorial is an article in a newspaper which gives the opinion of the editor or publisher on a topic or item of news.

words.tr: n. 事件；一集；一段经历；
words.ex: The accident was a sad episode in his life.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是他生命中的一件悲伤的事。
words.en: An episode is a part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio as one of a series, or a single event or group of related events.

words.ex: Follow the guideline to complete the form.
words.ex_cn: 按照指导路线完成表格。
words.en: A guideline is a set of rules or instructions that are given by an official organization telling you how to do something, especially something difficult.

words.ex: He found an old manuscript in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆里发现了一份旧手稿。
words.en: A manuscript is a handwritten or typed document, especially a writer's first version of a book before it is published.

words.ex: He wrote a memoir about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一本关于自己童年的回忆录。
words.en: A memoir is a book or article that you write about someone who you have known, describing what you remember of them and of particular events in which you both took part.

words.ex: He wrote a memorandum about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于会议的备忘录。
words.en: A memorandum is a written proposal or reminder, especially in a business context.

words.ex: I received a notification on my phone.
words.ex_cn: 我收到了手机上的一条通知。
words.en: A notification is a message, sound, or symbol that tells you that something has happened or that you need to do something.

words.ex: He handed me a pamphlet about the new park.
words.ex_cn: 他递给我一份关于新公园的小册子。
words.en: A pamphlet is a small book containing information on a particular subject or expressing political or religious views.

words.ex: He spent all day doing paperwork.
words.ex_cn: 他一整天都在处理文书工作。
words.en: Paperwork refers to the routine work involving written documents such as forms, reports, and letters, especially in an office setting.

words.ex: The students handed in a petition to the principal.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向校长递交了一份请愿书。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing.

words.ex: The two countries signed a protocol to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项停止战争的协议。
words.en: A protocol is a set of rules or a system of rules about the correct way to act in formal situations.

words.tr: n. 公民投票；全民公决；
words.ex: The country held a referendum to decide on the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家举行了公民投票来决定新法律。
words.en: A referendum is a direct vote in which an entire electorate is invited to vote on a particular proposal. This may result in the adoption of a new law.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

chapters.name: Word List 14 社会事物（三）民众

words.ex: He volunteers for civic projects in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他为家乡的市民项目做志愿者。
words.en: Relating to a city or town, especially its administration; relating to the duties or activities of people in relation to their town, city, or local area.

words.tr: adj. 国内的；公民的；民用的；
words.ex: The country is recovering from a civil war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在从一场内战中恢复。
words.en: relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns, as distinct from military or ecclesiastical matters.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.ex: He met a compatriot at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场遇到了一位同胞。
words.en: A compatriot is a person from your own country.

words.tr: n. 人群；集合在一起的群众；（教堂中的）会众
words.ex: A large congregation gathered in the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 一大群人聚集在广场上参加节日。
words.en: A congregation is a group of people who are gathered together in a church or synagogue for a religious service.

words.tr: n. 代表大会；议会；国会；
words.ex: The congress met to discuss new laws.
words.ex_cn: 代表大会召开以讨论新法律。
words.en: A congress is a formal meeting of representatives, as of various nations, to discuss problems or to make decisions.

words.tr: n. 剥夺国籍；剥夺公民权利；非国有化
words.ex: The law led to the denationalization of many immigrants.
words.ex_cn: 这项法律导致许多移民被剥夺国籍。
words.en: Denationalization refers to the process of transferring ownership of a business, industry, or service from the public sector (government) to the private sector.

words.ex: The electorate voted for a new leader.
words.ex_cn: 选民投票选出了新领导人。
words.en: The electorate refers to all the people in a country or area who are entitled to vote in an election.

words.ex: The inhabitant lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位居民住在一所小房子里。
words.en: An inhabitant of a place is one of the people who live there.

words.ex: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.ex: Pop music is part of the mainstream.
words.ex_cn: 流行音乐是主流的一部分。
words.en: The ideas, attitudes, or activities that are shared by most people and regarded as normal or conventional.

words.ex: The monarch ruled the country for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 这位君主统治这个国家长达50年。
words.en: A monarch is a king, queen, emperor, or empress.

words.ex: The rainbow is a natural phenomenon.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹是一种自然现象。
words.en: A phenomenon is something that is observed to happen or exist, especially something that is unusual or interesting.

words.ex: The mason built a stone wall with care.
words.ex_cn: 石匠仔细地砌了一堵石墙。
words.en: A mason is a person who builds or works with stone or brick.

chapters.name: Word List 14 社会事物（三）组织

words.ex: Dolphins are gregarious animals that swim in groups.
words.ex_cn: 海豚是群居动物，成群游泳。
words.en: Someone who is gregarious enjoys being with other people.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.ex: The corporation sells smartphones worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司向全球销售智能手机。
words.en: A corporation is a large company or group of companies that is controlled together as a single organization.

words.ex: The division of the cake was fair.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的划分是公平的。
words.en: The act or process of dividing something into parts or the state of being divided.

words.tr: n. 派系；派系斗争；内讧
words.ex: The faction argued loudly about the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 这个派别就新规定激烈争论。
words.en: A faction is a group of people within a larger group who have different opinions and beliefs from the rest of the group.

words.tr: adj. 联邦的；联邦制的；联邦政府的；
words.ex: The federal government passed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 联邦政府通过了一项新法律。
words.en: A federal system of government is one in which there is a central government and separate governments for each of the states or regions.

words.tr: n. 行会；同业公会；协会；
words.ex: The medieval guild controlled the price of bread.
words.ex_cn: 中世纪的行会控制了面包的价格。
words.en: A guild is an organization of people who do the same job or have the same interests.

chapters.name: Word List 14 社会事物（三）资格

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.tr: v. 命名；“entitle”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有资格的；
words.ex: They entitled the book 'The Silent Wind'.
words.ex_cn: 他们给这本书命名为《寂静的风》。
words.en: If you are entitled to something, you have the right to have it or do it.

chapters.name: Word List 14 社会事物（三）时代

words.tr: adj. 现代的；当代的；同时代的；
words.ex: This museum displays contemporary art.
words.ex_cn: 这个博物馆展示现代艺术。
words.en: Belonging to or occurring in the present; or a person or thing living or existing at the same time as another.

words.tr: adj. 新纪元的；划时代的
words.ex: The invention of the internet was an epochal event.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明是一个划时代的事件。
words.en: An epochal event or change is one that is very important and has a great effect on future events.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.tr:
adj. 青少年的；幼稚的；
n. 少年；
words.ex: The book is written for juvenile readers.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是为青少年读者撰写的。
words.en: A juvenile is a child or young person who is not yet old enough to be considered an adult.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.ex: The millennium began in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 一千年始于2000年。
words.en: A millennium is a period of one thousand years.

words.ex: This phone is outdated and doesn't work well.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了，用起来不好。
words.en: If you describe something as outdated, you mean that you think it is old-fashioned and no longer useful or relevant to modern life.

words.tr: adj. 过时的；老式的； v. “outmode”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This phone is outmoded and needs to be replaced.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机已经过时了，需要更换。
words.en: If you describe something as outmoded, you mean that you think it is old-fashioned and no longer useful or relevant to modern life.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

chapters.name: Word List 14 社会事物（三）种族

words.ex: The desegregation of schools was a significant step towards equality.
words.ex_cn: 学校的废止种族歧视是迈向平等的重要一步。
words.en: The process of ending a policy of racial segregation.

words.ex: The gypsy played violin on the street.
words.ex_cn: 吉卜赛人在街上拉小提琴。
words.en: A gypsy is a member of a race of people who travel from place to place, especially in Europe, and who traditionally live by seasonal work, music, and fortune-telling.

words.tr: v. 奴役；征服；使受控制
words.ex: The cruel king tried to enslave the villagers.
words.ex_cn: 这个残酷的国王试图奴役村民。
words.en: To make someone a slave; to take away someone's freedom.

words.ex: The festival celebrates ethnic music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日庆祝民族音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Ethnic relates to a group of people who have a common national or cultural tradition.

words.ex: His ethnicity is Chinese.
words.ex_cn: 他的种族渊源是中国。
words.en: Ethnicity is the fact or state of belonging to a social group that has a common national or cultural tradition.

words.tr: adj. 种族中心主义的；种族（或民族）优越感的
words.ex: His ethnocentric views alienated many of his colleagues.
words.ex_cn: 他的种族优越感观点使许多同事疏远了他。
words.en: Believing that the people, customs, and traditions of your own race or nationality are better than those of other races.

words.tr: adj. 人种学的；人种志学的；
words.ex: The anthropologist wrote an ethnographic study of the tribe.
words.ex_cn: 这位人类学家写了一篇关于这个部落的人种学研究。
words.en: Relating to the scientific description of peoples and cultures with their customs, habits, and mutual differences.

words.ex: He is studying ethnology at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里学习民族学。
words.en: Ethnology is the branch of anthropology that deals with the scientific description of individual human societies.

words.tr: adj. 不同种族的人的；种族间的
words.ex: They faced challenges due to their interracial relationship.
words.ex_cn: 他们由于跨种族关系而面临挑战。
words.en: Involving or existing between different races.

words.ex: The minority group voted for change.
words.ex_cn: 少数群体投票支持变革。
words.en: A minority is a group of people within a community or country who are different from the majority of the people there in race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.tr: adj. 种族主义的；种族歧视的；
words.ex: He made a racist comment about immigrants.
words.ex_cn: 他对移民发表了种族主义的言论。
words.en: A racist is someone who believes that people of their own race are superior to those of other races and who behaves in a way that shows this belief.

words.ex: The tribal people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 部落的人住在森林里。
words.en: Tribal relates to a tribe or tribes.

words.ex: The Spaniard speaks Spanish and loves flamenco.
words.ex_cn: 这位西班牙人说西班牙语，喜欢弗拉门戈。
words.en: A Spaniard is a person from Spain.

chapters.name: Word List 15 社会事物（四）亲属

words.ex: The clan lived in a small village for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这个氏族几个世纪以来一直住在一个小村庄里。
words.en: A clan is a group of families or relatives who are connected by blood or marriage and who often share the same surname.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.ex: My forebear came from Ireland long ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先很久以前来自爱尔兰。
words.en: Your forebears are your ancestors, especially your grandparents or earlier relatives.

words.tr: adj. （男性）家长制的；族长制的；父权制的
words.ex: He lives in a patriarchal family where the father makes all the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在一个父亲做所有决定的父权家庭中。
words.en: Relating to, characteristic of, or denoting a system of society or government controlled by men.

chapters.name: Word List 15 社会事物（四）货物

words.tr: adj. （男性）家长制的；族长制的；父权制的
words.ex: He lives in a patriarchal family where the father makes all the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在一个父亲做所有决定的父权家庭中。
words.en: Relating to, characteristic of, or denoting a system of society or government controlled by men.

chapters.name: Word List 15 社会事物（四）处所

words.tr: adj. （男性）家长制的；族长制的；父权制的
words.ex: He lives in a patriarchal family where the father makes all the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在一个父亲做所有决定的父权家庭中。
words.en: Relating to, characteristic of, or denoting a system of society or government controlled by men.

words.ex: The city cleaned the sewage from the streets.
words.ex_cn: 城市清理了街道上的污水。
words.en: Sewage is waste matter such as faeces or dirty water from homes and factories, which flows away through sewers.

words.tr: n. 下水道；排水沟；缝纫者
words.ex: The sewer smells bad after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后，下水道闻起来很难闻。
words.en: A sewer is a large underground channel that carries off waste water and refuse.

chapters.name: Word List 15 社会事物（四）运动

words.ex: He plays hockey every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打冰球。
words.en: Hockey is a sport played on ice or on a field, in which two teams try to hit a small hard object called a puck or a ball into the other team's goal using long curved sticks.

words.ex: He jogs every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上慢跑以保持健康。
words.en: To run at a slow, steady pace, especially as a form of exercise.

words.ex: The sudden jolt woke me up.
words.ex_cn: 突然的震动把我惊醒了。
words.en: If something jolts or if something jolts it, it moves suddenly and quite violently.

words.tr: vt. 超越，大大超过；把……抛在后面
words.ex: The champion runner outdistanced all the other competitors in the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位冠军选手在比赛中远远超过了其他所有竞争对手。
words.en: To outdistance someone or something means to be much better or more successful than they are.

words.ex: The outfield player made an impressive catch.
words.ex_cn: 外场球员完成了一次精彩的接球。
words.en: The part of the field in baseball that is farthest from the batter, where the outfielders play.

words.ex: The apple plummeted from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上垂直落下。
words.en: If an amount, rate, or price plummets, it decreases quickly by a large amount.

words.ex: The car had a slowdown near the school.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在学校附近减速了。
words.en: A slowdown is a reduction in speed or activity.

words.ex: The price of oil soared last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月石油价格骤升。
words.en: To rise or increase dramatically in amount or level.

words.tr:
n. 螺旋形；陡升或骤降；
v. 螺旋式上升（或下降）；
adj. 螺旋形的；
words.ex: The snail moved along a spiral path.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛沿着一个螺旋形的路径爬行。
words.en: A spiral is a shape which winds round and round, with each curve above or outside the previous one.

words.tr:
v. 大步行走；跨一大步
n. 大步；步伐
words.ex: He takes a long stride when he walks.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时迈着大步。
words.en: To walk with long, decisive steps in a specified direction.

words.ex: They traverse the forest to reach the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们横穿森林去到达村庄。
words.en: To traverse something means to move or travel across it, often with some difficulty.

chapters.name: Word List 15 社会事物（四）思想

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.ex: His intention was to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.tr: phrase. 育儿假；父母在孩子出生后或领养孩子期间依法享有的带薪或无薪休假
words.ex: She took parental leave after her baby was born.
words.ex_cn: 她生完孩子后休了育儿假。
words.en: Parental leave is a period of time that a mother or father is allowed to spend away from work to take care of their new baby or newly adopted child.

words.tr: adj. 善于接受的；能接纳的；
words.ex: He is receptive to new ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他善于接受新想法。
words.en: Willing to consider or accept new suggestions and ideas.

words.tr: adj. 记性好的；有保持力的
words.ex: She has a very retentive memory.
words.ex_cn: 她有非常好的记忆力。
words.en: If you have a retentive memory, you are able to remember things easily.

words.ex: His sentiment about the new policy is positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对新政策的看法是积极的。
words.en: A sentiment is a thought, opinion, or idea based on a feeling about a situation, or a way of thinking about something.

words.ex: From my standpoint, this plan is too risky.
words.ex_cn: 从我的立场来看，这个计划太冒险了。
words.en: A standpoint is a particular way of considering something, or a particular attitude towards it.

words.ex: The university has great prestige for its research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学因其研究而享有很高的声望。
words.en: The widespread respect and admiration felt for someone or something on the basis of a perception of their achievements or quality.

chapters.name: Word List 15 社会事物（四）残留物

words.ex: The residue left in the cup was sugar.
words.ex_cn: 杯子里留下的残留物是糖。
words.en: A residue of something is a small amount that remains after the main part has gone or been taken or used.

words.ex: Rivers carry sediment to the sea.
words.ex_cn: 河流把沉积物带到大海。
words.en: Material that settles to the bottom of a liquid; matter that has been deposited by some natural process.

words.ex: The old house has a vestige of its original design.
words.ex_cn: 这座老房子还保留着它原始设计的痕迹。
words.en: A vestige is a small part or amount of something that remains after the rest has disappeared or been destroyed.

words.ex: The storm left only wreckage on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 风暴在海滩上只留下了残骸。
words.en: The remains of something that has been badly damaged or destroyed.

chapters.name: Word List 15 社会事物（四）科学（家）

words.ex: The company improved its logistics to deliver packages faster.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司改进了物流，以更快地配送包裹。
words.en: Logistics refers to the detailed organization and implementation of a complex operation.

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.ex: The paleontologist found a dinosaur bone in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 古生物学家在沙漠中发现了一块恐龙骨头。
words.en: A paleontologist is a scientist who studies fossils to understand the history of life on Earth.

words.ex: He is researching parapsychology to understand telepathy.
words.ex_cn: 他正在研究超心理学以理解心灵感应。
words.en: The study of mental phenomena that are excluded from or inexplicable by orthodox scientific psychology.

words.ex: He is studying pathology to understand diseases.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习病理学以了解疾病。
words.en: Pathology is the study of the causes and effects of diseases, especially the branch of medicine that deals with the laboratory examination of samples of body tissue for diagnostic or forensic purposes.

words.ex: He studies pharmacology to understand how drugs work.
words.ex_cn: 他学习药理学以了解药物如何发挥作用。
words.en: Pharmacology is the branch of medicine concerned with the uses, effects, and modes of action of drugs.

words.ex: He studies physiology to understand how the human body works.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生理学以了解人体如何运作。
words.en: The branch of biology that deals with the normal functions of living organisms and their parts.

words.ex: Astrology is often called a pseudoscience.
words.ex_cn: 占星术常被称为伪科学。
words.en: A system of thought or a methodology which is falsely presented as scientific.

words.ex: The policy helps low-income, socio-economic groups.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策帮助了低收入的社会经济群体。
words.en: Relating to the interaction of social and economic factors.

chapters.name: Word List 15 社会事物（四）顶点

words.ex: The policy helps low-income, socio-economic groups.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策帮助了低收入的社会经济群体。
words.en: Relating to the interaction of social and economic factors.

chapters.name: Word List 15 社会事物（四）出售

words.ex: The policy helps low-income, socio-economic groups.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策帮助了低收入的社会经济群体。
words.en: Relating to the interaction of social and economic factors.

chapters.name: Word List 16 自然事物 气象

words.ex: The air feels humid after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气感觉湿润。
words.en: You use humid to describe an atmosphere or climate that is very damp, and usually very hot.

words.ex: The weather was inclement, so we stayed home.
words.ex_cn: 天气恶劣，所以我们待在家里。
words.en: (of weather) unpleasantly cold or wet.

words.ex: The meteorologist predicts rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 气象学家预测明天会下雨。
words.en: A meteorologist is a scientist who studies the atmosphere and its phenomena, especially in relation to weather and weather forecasting.

words.tr: n. （英）古气候学家（paleoclimatology 的变形）
words.ex: The paleoclimatologist studied ancient climate patterns to understand current environmental changes.
words.ex_cn: 这位古气候学家研究古代气候模式以理解当前的环境变化。
words.en: A paleoclimatologist is a scientist who studies the climates of past ages.

words.tr:
v. 加速（坏事的发生）
n. 沉淀物；冷凝物
adj. 轻率的；仓促的
words.ex: The scandal precipitated the politician's resignation.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻加速了这位政治家的辞职。
words.en: To cause something to happen suddenly or unexpectedly; to cause a substance to be deposited in solid form from a solution.

words.ex: The city has heavy smog in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市冬天有严重的雾霾。
words.en: Smog is a mixture of smoke and fog, or a similar mixture of air pollutants, which can be harmful to health.

words.tr: n. 平流层；同温层；最高层；
words.ex: Planes fly in the stratosphere to avoid bad weather.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在平流层飞行以避开恶劣天气。
words.en: The stratosphere is the second major layer of Earth's atmosphere, just above the troposphere, and below the mesosphere. It is characterized by a slight temperature increase with altitude and the presence of the ozone layer, which absorbs and scatters the solar ultraviolet radiation.

chapters.name: Word List 16 自然事物 其他

words.ex: She wore a necklace made of amber.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一条琥珀制成的项链。
words.en: Amber is a hard, translucent, yellowish-brown substance that is used for making jewelry or other objects. It is formed from the resin of ancient trees.

words.tr:
n. 冰雹；
v. 把…誉为；
words.ex: The hail broke many car windows.
words.ex_cn: 冰雹打碎了许多汽车窗户。
words.en: Hail is small balls of ice that fall like rain from the sky. It can also mean to call out to someone in order to attract their attention, or to praise someone enthusiastically.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: She saw the aurora in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 她在夜空中看到了极光。
words.en: An aurora is a natural light display in the sky, predominantly seen in the high latitude (Arctic and Antarctic) regions, caused by the collision of solar wind and magnetospheric charged particles with the high altitude atmosphere.

words.ex: Applications arrived in an avalanche after the job posting.
words.ex_cn: 职位发布后，申请纷至沓来。
words.en: An avalanche is a large mass of snow, ice, and rocks that falls quickly down the side of a mountain.

words.tr: n. 一阵强劲的气流；爆炸；
words.ex: A blast of cold wind hit the window.
words.ex_cn: 一阵冷风击中了窗户。
words.en: A blast is a sudden loud noise or a strong gust of wind. It can also refer to an explosion or the act of blowing something up. As a verb, it means to explode or to criticize severely.

words.ex: The bomb left a deep crater in the road.
words.ex_cn: 炸弹在道路上炸出了一个深深的弹坑。
words.en: A crater is a large hole in the ground, typically caused by an explosion or the impact of a meteorite.

words.tr:
n. 大洪水；暴雨；泛滥
v. 泛滥；大量涌入
words.ex: The rain caused a deluge in the town.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨在镇上引发了洪水。
words.en: A deluge is a severe flood or a very heavy fall of rain that causes a lot of damage.

words.tr: phrase. 生态系统；指生物与其环境相互作用的自然系统
words.ex: The study of ecological systems helps us understand the balance of nature.
words.ex_cn: 生态系统的研究帮助我们理解自然的平衡。
words.en: Ecological systems refer to the complex network of interactions among organisms and their environment, functioning as a unit.

words.ex: He studies ecology to understand how animals live with plants.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生态学以了解动物如何与植物共存。
words.en: Ecology is the study of the relationships between living organisms, including humans, and their physical environment; it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them.

words.ex: The glacier moves slowly down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 冰川缓慢地沿着山向下移动。
words.en: A glacier is a large, persistent body of ice that forms where the accumulation of snow exceeds its ablation over many years, often centuries.

words.ex: The table is made of granite.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是花岗岩做的。
words.en: Granite is a very hard rock that is often used in building.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

chapters.name: Word List 16 普通状态（一）正常

words.ex: This is a commonplace event in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 这在大城市里是件普通的事。
words.en: Something that is commonplace is ordinary and not very interesting.

words.ex: He follows the orthodox religious practices.
words.ex_cn: 他遵循正统的宗教习俗。
words.en: Orthodox beliefs, methods, or systems are ones which are accepted or used by most people.

words.tr:
n. 常规；例行公事；
adj. 常规的；例行公事的；
words.ex: He follows a morning routine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循固定的惯例。
words.en: A routine is a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.

chapters.name: Word List 16 普通状态（一）异常

words.ex: The boy has an abnormal heartbeat.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩的心跳不正常。
words.en: Deviating from what is normal or usual, typically in a way that is undesirable or worrying.

words.tr: adj. 偏离规则的；反常的
words.ex: The temperature was anomalous for this season.
words.ex_cn: 这个季节的温度异常。
words.en: Deviating from what is standard, normal, or expected.

words.tr: adj. 外来的；外国来的；奇异的；
words.ex: The market sells exotic fruits from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售来自其他国家的外来水果。
words.en: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

words.tr: adj. 地球外的；地外的；外星球的；
words.ex: The movie shows an extraterrestrial life form.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一种地球外的生命形式。
words.en: An extraterrestrial is a creature that comes from or exists outside the planet Earth.

words.ex: His views were considered heretical by the religious authorities.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点被宗教权威认为是异端的。
words.en: If someone's beliefs or actions are heretical, they are contrary to the official or accepted beliefs or practices of a particular religion or group.

words.tr: adj. 少有的；不经常的；罕见的；
words.ex: He makes infrequent visits to his hometown.
words.ex_cn: 他很少回老家。
words.en: If something is infrequent, it does not happen often.

words.ex: The inverse order of the numbers is 5, 4, 3, 2, 1.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的倒序是5、4、3、2、1。
words.en: If there is an inverse relationship between two things, one of them becomes larger as the other becomes smaller.

words.tr: adj. 倾向一方的；不平衡的；悬殊的
words.ex: The game was lopsided, and one team won by 10 points.
words.ex_cn: 这场比赛比分悬殊，一支队伍以10分获胜。
words.en: Something that is lopsided is uneven because one side is lower or heavier than the other.

words.ex: The child's recovery was a miracle.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的康复是个奇迹。
words.en: A miracle is an event that cannot be explained by the laws of nature and is therefore considered to be the work of a divine agency.

words.ex: The nontarget species were not affected by the pesticide.
words.ex_cn: 非目标物种不受杀虫剂的影响。
words.en: Not intended as a target or not being the main focus.

words.ex: The toy store sells many novelty items for children.
words.ex_cn: 玩具店出售许多为儿童设计的新奇物品。
words.en: The quality of being new, original, or unusual; something new, original, or unusual.

words.tr: adj. 超常的；超过正常范围的
words.ex: Many people are fascinated by paranormal phenomena.
words.ex_cn: 许多人对超自然现象感到着迷。
words.en: Paranormal events or phenomena are those that are beyond the scope of normal scientific understanding.

words.tr: adj. 不合常规的；不符合惯例的；不寻常的；
words.ex: He wears unconventional clothes to stand out.
words.ex_cn: 他穿不合常规的衣服来引人注目。
words.en: If you describe a person or their attitude or behaviour as unconventional, you mean that they do not behave in the same way as most other people in their society.

words.ex: The weather is unpredictable today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气不可预测。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as unpredictable, you mean that you cannot tell what they are going to do or how they are going to behave.

words.tr: adj. 不切实际的；不实事求是的；
words.ex: It's unrealistic to expect to get rich quickly.
words.ex_cn: 指望快速致富是不切实际的。
words.en: If you say that someone is being unrealistic, you mean that they do not recognize the truth about a situation, especially about the difficulties involved in something they want to achieve.

words.tr: adj. 难以捍卫的；站不住脚的；不堪一击的
words.ex: His excuse was untenable.
words.ex_cn: 他的借口站不住脚。
words.en: If an argument, theory, or position is untenable, it cannot be defended or supported against criticism.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

chapters.name: Word List 16 普通状态（一）随机

words.ex: He had an accidental fall while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他在走路时不小心摔了一跤。
words.en: An accidental event happens by chance, without being planned.

words.ex: The teacher chose an arbitrary number to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师随意选了一个数字来开始游戏。
words.en: If you describe an action, rule, or decision as arbitrary, you think that it is not based on any principle, plan, or system. It often seems unfair because of this.

words.ex: The trip is contingent on the weather.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行取决于天气情况。
words.en: A contingent event or situation depends on something else in order to happen or exist.

words.ex: He arranged the books in a haphazard way.
words.ex_cn: 他随意地摆放了书。
words.en: If you describe something as haphazard, you are critical of it because it is not at all organized or is not arranged according to a plan.

words.tr: adj. 无辔头的；不受控制的；放纵的
words.ex: The unbridled horse ran across the field.
words.ex_cn: 那匹无辔头的马在田野上奔跑。
words.en: If you describe behaviour or feelings as unbridled, you mean that they are not controlled or limited in any way.

chapters.name: Word List 16 普通状态（一）精确

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.ex: He took his words in a literal sense.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的话按字面意思理解。
words.en: If you describe something as the literal truth or a literal fact, you are emphasizing that it is true.

words.tr: adj. 精密复杂的；老练的；
words.ex: The phone has a sophisticated camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个精密复杂的摄像头。
words.en: A sophisticated person is intelligent and knows a lot, so that they are able to understand complicated situations. A sophisticated machine, device, or method is more advanced or complex than others.

chapters.name: Word List 16 普通状态（一）对立

words.ex: He faced his adversary in the final match.
words.ex_cn: 他在决赛中对阵对手。
words.en: An adversary is someone who you are competing with, or who is opposing you or what you are trying to do.

words.ex: The adverse weather delayed the flight.
words.ex_cn: 不利的天气延误了航班。
words.en: If something is adverse, it is harmful or unfavorable.

words.tr: n. 对抗；对立；敌对状态（行为）
words.ex: There is antagonism between the two neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这两个邻居之间有敌意。
words.en: Antagonism is a strong feeling of dislike or opposition towards someone or something.

words.ex: His calmness is the antithesis of her anger.
words.ex_cn: 他的冷静是她愤怒的反面。
words.en: The antithesis of something is its exact opposite.

words.tr: n. 主要敌人，大敌；撒旦，魔王
words.ex: The superhero's archenemy was a powerful villain with a personal vendetta.
words.ex_cn: 这位超级英雄的主要敌人是一个有着私人恩怨的强大反派。
words.en: An archenemy is the main enemy of someone or something, often portrayed as a formidable opponent.

words.ex: He saw his neighbor as a foe.
words.ex_cn: 他把邻居看作敌人。
words.en: A foe is someone who opposes or fights against another; an enemy.

words.ex: The hostile neighbor shouted at us every morning.
words.ex_cn: 那个敌意的邻居每天早上都对我们大喊大叫。
words.en: If you are hostile to another person or an idea, you disagree with them or disapprove of them, often showing this in your behavior.

words.tr: adj. 排斥（性）的；排除在外的
words.ex: The club has an exclusionary policy.
words.ex_cn: 这个俱乐部有排他性的政策。
words.en: If you describe a policy, practice, or law as exclusionary, you mean that it tends to keep certain people, especially those from a particular group, from participating in something or from enjoying certain rights.

chapters.name: Word List 16 普通状态（一）模糊

words.tr: adj. 模棱两可的；含糊不清的；
words.ex: His answer was ambiguous and confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答模棱两可，让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: If you describe something as ambiguous, you mean that it is unclear or confusing because it can be understood in more than one way.

words.tr:
v. 使模糊；使看不清；弄污
n. 模糊
words.ex: The rain made the lights blur.
words.ex_cn: 雨使灯光变得模糊。
words.en: If something blurs your vision, it makes you unable to see things clearly.

words.tr: adj. 模棱两可的；含糊其词的；难以解释的
words.ex: His answer was equivocal.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答模棱两可。
words.en: If you are equivocal, you are deliberately vague in what you say, because you want to avoid speaking the truth or making a decision.

words.tr:
n. 织布机；
v. 迫近；
words.ex: The old loom made a loud clicking sound.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧织布机发出很大的咔嗒声。
words.en: If something looms over you, it appears as a large or unclear shape, often in a way that is frightening or causes worry.

words.ex: The meaning of the poem is obscure.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的意思不清楚。
words.en: If something is obscure, it is not well known or not easily understood.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

chapters.name: Word List 16 普通状态（一）清晰

words.tr: adj. 可觉察的；很可观的
words.ex: There is an appreciable difference in his grades.
words.ex_cn: 他的成绩有明显的差异。
words.en: If something is appreciable, it is large enough to be noticed or considered important.

words.ex: Can you clarify your answer?
words.ex_cn: 你能澄清一下你的答案吗？
words.en: To clarify something means to make it easier to understand by explaining it more clearly.

words.ex: He gave an explicit answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了明确的答案。
words.en: Something that is explicit is expressed or shown clearly and openly, without any attempt to hide anything.

words.ex: He expressly told me not to be late.
words.ex_cn: 他特意告诉我不要迟到。
words.en: If something is said or done expressly, it is said or done in a clear, deliberate way.

words.ex: The manifestation of his anger was a loud shout.
words.ex_cn: 他愤怒的显示是一声大喊。
words.en: A manifestation is an event, action, or object that clearly shows or embodies something, especially a theory or an abstract idea.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.tr: v. 发音；宣告；“pronounce”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 显著的；
words.ex: He pronounced the word correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地发音了这个单词。
words.en: Something that is pronounced is very noticeable or obvious.

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.tr: adj. 特定的；明确的；具体的；
words.ex: He gave a specific reason for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个迟到的具体原因。
words.en: If someone is specific, they give a description that is precise and exact.

chapters.name: Word List 16 普通状态（一）平衡

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.ex: The teacher showed a bias for students who arrived early.
words.ex_cn: 老师对早到的学生有偏爱。
words.en: If someone is biased, they prefer one group of people to another, and behave unfairly as a result.

words.ex: The two kids stayed in equilibrium on the seesaw.
words.ex_cn: 两个孩子在跷跷板上保持了平衡。
words.en: A state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced.

words.tr: v. 使边缘化；忽略；排斥
words.ex: They marginalize the poor in this city.
words.ex_cn: 他们在这个城市边缘化穷人。
words.en: To marginalize a group of people means to make them feel isolated and unimportant.

words.ex: The doctor tried to stabilize the patient's heart rate.
words.ex_cn: 医生试图稳定病人的脉搏。
words.en: To stabilize something means to make it stable or to prevent it from changing or declining.

words.ex: There is a tendency for people to use phones before bed.
words.ex_cn: 人们在睡觉前使用手机是一种趋势。
words.en: A tendency is a likelihood of behaving in a particular way or going in a particular direction, which is often bad or undesirable.

words.tr:
v. （使）倾斜；（使）偏向
n. 倾斜；企图
words.ex: The boy tilt the cup and spill the water.
words.ex_cn: 男孩把杯子倾斜，水洒了出来。
words.en: If you tilt an object or if it tilts, it moves into a sloping position with one end or side higher than the other.

chapters.name: Word List 17 普通状态（二）奇怪

words.ex: He felt awkward when he forgot his friend's name.
words.ex_cn: 当他忘记朋友的名字时，他感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you describe a situation as awkward, you mean that it is embarrassing or difficult to deal with.

words.tr: adj. 离奇的；奇特的；奇怪的；
words.ex: The clown wore a bizarre hat with three eyes.
words.ex_cn: 小丑戴着一顶有三只眼睛的离奇帽子。
words.en: Something that is bizarre is very odd and strange.

words.tr: adj. 不稳定的；飘忽不定的；
words.ex: The weather has been erratic this month.
words.ex_cn: 这个月的天气一直不稳定。
words.en: Something that is erratic does not follow a regular pattern, but happens at unexpected times or moves in unexpected directions.

chapters.name: Word List 17 普通状态（二）一致

words.ex: His opinion coincides with mine.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点与我的一致。
words.en: If one event coincides with another, they happen at the same time.

words.ex: The team reached a consensus on the project plan.
words.ex_cn: 团队就项目计划达成了共识。
words.en: A consensus is general agreement among a group of people.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.tr: adj. 混合的; v. 混合；掺杂（intermingle 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: The colors were intermingled on the canvas.
words.ex_cn: 画布上的颜色混合在一起。
words.en: If things intermingle, they mix together or become mixed together.

words.ex: The internet is a nexus of information.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是信息的联系中心。
words.en: A nexus is a connection or series of connections within a particular situation or system.

words.tr:
adj. 成比例的；相应的；相称的
v. 使成比例；使适应
words.ex: The punishment should be proportionate to the crime.
words.ex_cn: 惩罚应当与罪行相称。
words.en: If one thing is proportionate to another, it increases or decreases according to the changes in the other thing, and there is a sensible relationship between them.

words.ex: He likens his job to a puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的工作比作一个拼图。
words.en: To liken something to something else is to say that they are similar in some way.

words.ex: The two cars collided at the intersection.
words.ex_cn: 两辆车在十字路口相撞了。
words.en: If two or more moving people or objects collide, they crash into one another.

chapters.name: Word List 17 普通状态（二）方便

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 权宜之计；应急办法
adj. 权宜的
words.ex: Closing the factory was an expedient to save money.
words.ex_cn: 关闭工厂是为了省钱的权宜之计。
words.en: An expedient action or solution to a problem is one that is convenient or practical, although it may not be morally right.

words.ex: The road closure caused an inconvenience to commuters.
words.ex_cn: 道路封闭给通勤者带来了不便。
words.en: Inconvenience refers to the state or quality of being inconvenient; trouble or difficulty caused to one's personal requirements or comfort.

chapters.name: Word List 17 普通状态（二）严厉、严肃

words.tr: adj. 娴静的；端庄的；假装矜持的
words.ex: She is a demure girl who never speaks loudly.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个文静的女孩，从不大声说话。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a young woman, as demure, you mean they are quiet, shy, and behave so that they do not attract attention to themselves.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.ex: The school has stringent rules about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学校对作业有严格的规定。
words.en: Stringent measures, rules, or conditions are very strict or severe.

chapters.name: Word List 17 普通状态（二）困境

words.ex: He faced a dilemma: stay home or go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困境：是待在家里还是去上班。
words.en: A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially equally undesirable ones.

words.ex: The village suffered from famine last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个村庄遭受了饥荒。
words.en: A famine is a serious shortage of food in a country, which may cause many people to get sick or die.

words.ex: The war impoverished many families.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争使许多家庭变得贫困。
words.en: To make someone poor or to reduce the quality, strength, or richness of something.

words.ex: The indigent man asked for food at the shelter.
words.ex_cn: 这位贫困的人在收容所里请求食物。
words.en: Someone who is indigent is very poor.

words.tr: adj. 不能调和的；无法化解的；不兼容的
words.ex: Their views are irreconcilable.
words.ex_cn: 他们的观点无法调和。
words.en: If two things such as opinions or proposals are irreconcilable, they are so different from each other that it is not possible to believe or have both of them.

words.tr: n. 困境；窘境；困惑之境；进退两难
words.ex: He is in a quandary about what to do.
words.ex_cn: 他对于该做什么感到困惑。
words.en: A situation in which you are unsure or confused about what to do.

chapters.name: Word List 17 普通状态（二）混乱

words.tr: v. 使动摇；使不安定；使不稳定
words.ex: The rumor destabilized the company's leadership.
words.ex_cn: 这个谣言动摇了公司的领导层。
words.en: To destabilize something means to make it less stable or to cause it to become unstable.

words.ex: The room was in complete disorder.
words.ex_cn: 房间一片混乱。
words.en: A disorder is a state of confusion or untidiness, or a medical problem that affects the mind or body.

words.ex: The storm disrupted the train service.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴中断了火车服务。
words.en: To disrupt a system, process, or event means to prevent it from continuing or operating in a normal way.

words.tr: adj. 破坏性的；引起混乱的；
words.ex: The new technology caused disruptive changes in the market.
words.ex_cn: 这项新技术给市场带来了破坏性的变化。
words.en: Causing or tending to cause disruption.

words.ex: The noise from the construction caused a disturbance.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工地的噪音造成了干扰。
words.en: A disturbance is an event or situation in which people behave in a noisy or violent way, or something that interrupts what you are doing.

words.tr: n. 大破坏；大毁坏；大混乱；
words.ex: The storm caused havoc in the small town.
words.ex_cn: 风暴给这个小镇带来了大破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as havoc, you mean that it causes a great deal of disorder, confusion, or destruction.

words.ex: He bought some miscellaneous items at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店里买了一些各种各样的东西。
words.en: Consisting of a variety of ingredients or parts.

words.ex: The new policy is problematic for small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策对小企业来说成问题。
words.en: If something is problematic, it involves problems and is difficult to deal with or solve.

words.tr: adj. 似是而非的；貌似有理的
words.ex: His argument is specious and misleading.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点看似有理但具有误导性。
words.en: Something that is specious seems to be good, sound, or correct but is actually wrong or false.

words.tr: adj. 狂暴的；骚动的；动荡的；汹涌的
words.ex: The turbulent sea made the boat shake.
words.ex_cn: 汹涌的海让船摇晃。
words.en: A turbulent situation, time, or relationship is one in which there is a lot of change, confusion, and often conflict.

words.tr: n. 混乱；动荡；骚乱；恐慌
words.ex: The storm caused turmoil in the town.
words.ex_cn: 风暴给小镇带来了混乱。
words.en: A state of great disturbance, confusion, or uncertainty.

chapters.name: Word List 17 普通状态（二）和谐

words.ex: The dissonant notes made the music sound unpleasant.
words.ex_cn: 这些不和谐的音符让音乐听起来很难听。
words.en: If something is dissonant, it is not harmonious or consistent; it may refer to sounds that are harsh and unpleasant or to ideas, opinions, or elements that are in disagreement.

words.tr: v. 使协调一致；使和谐；配上和音
words.ex: The two singers try to harmonize their voices.
words.ex_cn: 两位歌手试图让他们的声音和谐。
words.en: If two or more things harmonize, they combine in a pleasing way, or if you harmonize them, you make them combine in a pleasing way.

words.tr: adj. 不兼容的；不相配的；
words.ex: The software is incompatible with old systems.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件与旧系统不兼容。
words.en: If one thing or person is incompatible with another, they are very different in important ways, and do not suit each other or agree with each other.

words.ex: He tried to reconcile his work and family life.
words.ex_cn: 他试图调和工作与家庭生活。
words.en: If you reconcile two beliefs, facts, or demands that seem to be opposed or completely different, you find a way in which they can both be true or both be successful.

words.ex: The workers showed solidarity during the strike.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在罢工期间表现出团结。
words.en: Solidarity is unity or agreement of feeling or action, especially among individuals with a common interest; mutual support within a group.

words.ex: She was sympathetic to his problems.
words.ex_cn: 她对他的问题很同情。
words.en: If you are sympathetic to someone who is in a bad situation, you are kind to them and show that you understand their feelings.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

chapters.name: Word List 17 普通状态（二）危险

words.tr: v. 使遭危险或伤害；危害；危及
words.ex: Pollution can endanger animals.
words.ex_cn: 污染会危及动物。
words.en: To put someone or something at risk or in danger.

words.ex: The chemicals are hazardous to health.
words.ex_cn: 这些化学物质对健康有危险。
words.en: Something that is hazardous is dangerous, especially to people's health or safety.

words.ex: Smoking can imperil your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会危及你的健康。
words.en: To put someone or something at risk of being harmed, damaged, or destroyed.

words.ex: Don't jeopardize your health by skipping meals.
words.ex_cn: 不要因为不吃饭而危及你的健康。
words.en: To jeopardize something means to do something that may destroy it or cause it to be lost.

words.ex: The broken bridge is a menace to drivers.
words.ex_cn: 这座破桥对司机来说是个危险物。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a menace, you mean that they are likely to cause serious harm.

words.tr: adj. 不安全的；危险的；不稳当的；
words.ex: The ladder was precarious and might fall.
words.ex_cn: 梯子不安全，可能会倒。
words.en: If a situation is precarious, it is uncertain or dangerous, and could get worse or fail.

words.tr:
n. 冒险事业；商业冒险；投机；
v. 冒险；投机；
words.ex: He started a new venture in technology.
words.ex_cn: 他创办了一项新的科技冒险事业。
words.en: If you venture somewhere, you go somewhere that might be dangerous. If you venture a question or statement, you say it in an uncertain way because you are afraid it might be stupid or wrong.

chapters.name: Word List 17 普通状态（二）灭绝

words.ex: The farmer tried to exterminate the rats.
words.ex_cn: 农夫试图消灭老鼠。
words.en: To exterminate means to kill all the members of a group of people or animals, or to destroy something completely.

words.tr: adj. 灭绝的；熄灭的；绝种的；
words.ex: The dodo is an extinct bird.
words.ex_cn: 渡渡鸟是一种灭绝的鸟。
words.en: If a species of animals or plants is extinct, it no longer has any living members, either in the world or in a particular place.

words.ex: The extinction of dinosaurs happened millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的灭绝发生在数百万年前。
words.en: The state or process of a species, family, or larger group being or becoming extinct.

words.ex: He extinguished the fire with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水把火扑灭了。
words.en: To extinguish a fire or a light means to stop it burning or shining.

words.ex: The mortality rate in the region increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年该地区的死亡率上升了。
words.en: Mortality refers to the state of being subject to death or the number of deaths in a particular population or period.

words.ex: The newspaper published his obituary yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 报纸昨天刊登了他的讣告。
words.en: An obituary is a notice of a person's death, especially in a newspaper, often with a brief biography of the deceased.

words.ex: The flowers will perish if you don't water them.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不给花浇水，它们会死。
words.en: If people or animals perish, they die as a result of very harsh conditions or as the result of an accident.

chapters.name: Word List 17 普通状态（二）适合

words.ex: Wearing shorts to the meeting is inappropriate.
words.ex_cn: 穿短裤去参加会议是不合适的。
words.en: If you say that something is inappropriate, you are criticizing it because you think it is not suitable for a particular situation or purpose.

words.tr: adj. 不适当的；无能的；笨拙的
words.ex: His inept reply made the situation worse.
words.ex_cn: 他不适当的回答让情况变得更糟。
words.en: If you say that someone is inept, you are criticizing them because they do something with a complete lack of skill.

words.tr: adj. 适应不良的；不适应的；不利于适应的
words.ex: He uses maladaptive habits to deal with stress.
words.ex_cn: 他用不适应的方式应对压力。
words.en: Not providing adequate or appropriate adjustment to the environment or situation.

chapters.name: Word List 17 普通状态（二）强烈

words.tr: adj. 敏锐的；急性的；严重的；
words.ex: He has an acute mind and solves problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他思维敏锐，能快速解决问题。
words.en: An acute problem or negative feeling is very severe.
